4!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5! Purpose:
6!
7! Interface from Zhang-McFarlane convection scheme, includes evaporation of convective
8! precip from the ZM scheme
9!
10! Apr 2006: RBN: Code added to perform a dilute ascent for closure of the CM mass flux
11! based on an entraining plume a la Raymond and Blythe (1992)
12!
13! Author: Byron Boville, from code in tphysbc
14!
15!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

150!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
151!
152! Purpose:
153! Main driver for zhang-mcfarlane convection scheme
154!
155! Method:
156! performs deep convective adjustment based on mass-flux closure
157! algorithm.
158!
159! Author:guang jun zhang, m.lazare, n.mcfarlane. CAM Contact: P. Rasch
160!
161! This is contributed code not fully standardized by the CAM core group.
162! All variables have been typed, where most are identified in comments
163! The current procedure will be reimplemented in a subsequent version
164! of the CAM where it will include a more straightforward formulation
165! and will make use of the standard CAM nomenclature
166!
167!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
168 use phys_control, only: cam_physpkg_is
169
170!
171! ************************ index of variables **********************
172!
173! wg * alpha array of vertical differencing used (=1. for upstream).
174! w * cape convective available potential energy.
175! wg * capeg gathered convective available potential energy.
176! c * capelmt threshold value for cape for deep convection.
177! ic * cpres specific heat at constant pressure in j/kg-degk.
178! i * dpp
179! ic * delt length of model time-step in seconds.
180! wg * dp layer thickness in mbs (between upper/lower interface).
181! wg * dqdt mixing ratio tendency at gathered points.
182! wg * dsdt dry static energy ("temp") tendency at gathered points.
183! wg * dudt u-wind tendency at gathered points.
184! wg * dvdt v-wind tendency at gathered points.
185! wg * dsubcld layer thickness in mbs between lcl and maxi.
186! ic * grav acceleration due to gravity in m/sec2.
187! wg * du detrainment in updraft. specified in mid-layer
188! wg * ed entrainment in downdraft.
189! wg * eu entrainment in updraft.
190! wg * hmn moist static energy.
191! wg * hsat saturated moist static energy.
192! w * ideep holds position of gathered points vs longitude index.
193! ic * pver number of model levels.
194! wg * j0 detrainment initiation level index.
195! wg * jd downdraft initiation level index.
196! ic * jlatpr gaussian latitude index for printing grids (if needed).
197! wg * jt top level index of deep cumulus convection.
198! w * lcl base level index of deep cumulus convection.
199! wg * lclg gathered values of lcl.
200! w * lel index of highest theoretical convective plume.
201! wg * lelg gathered values of lel.
202! w * lon index of onset level for deep convection.
203! w * maxi index of level with largest moist static energy.
204! wg * maxg gathered values of maxi.
205! wg * mb cloud base mass flux.
206! wg * mc net upward (scaled by mb) cloud mass flux.
207! wg * md downward cloud mass flux (positive up).
208! wg * mu upward cloud mass flux (positive up). specified
209! at interface
210! ic * msg number of missing moisture levels at the top of model.
211! w * p grid slice of ambient mid-layer pressure in mbs.
212! i * pblt row of pbl top indices.
213! w * pcpdh scaled surface pressure.
214! w * pf grid slice of ambient interface pressure in mbs.
215! wg * pg grid slice of gathered values of p.
216! w * q grid slice of mixing ratio.
217! wg * qd grid slice of mixing ratio in downdraft.
218! wg * qg grid slice of gathered values of q.
219! i/o * qh grid slice of specific humidity.
220! w * qh0 grid slice of initial specific humidity.
221! wg * qhat grid slice of upper interface mixing ratio.
222! wg * ql grid slice of cloud liquid water.
223! wg * qs grid slice of saturation mixing ratio.
224! w * qstp grid slice of parcel temp. saturation mixing ratio.
225! wg * qstpg grid slice of gathered values of qstp.
226! wg * qu grid slice of mixing ratio in updraft.
227! ic * rgas dry air gas constant.
228! wg * rl latent heat of vaporization.
229! w * s grid slice of scaled dry static energy (t+gz/cp).
230! wg * sd grid slice of dry static energy in downdraft.
231! wg * sg grid slice of gathered values of s.
232! wg * shat grid slice of upper interface dry static energy.
233! wg * su grid slice of dry static energy in updraft.
234! i/o * t
235! o * jctop row of top-of-deep-convection indices passed out.
236! O * jcbot row of base of cloud indices passed out.
237! wg * tg grid slice of gathered values of t.
238! w * tl row of parcel temperature at lcl.
239! wg * tlg grid slice of gathered values of tl.
240! w * tp grid slice of parcel temperatures.
241! wg * tpg grid slice of gathered values of tp.
242! i/o * u grid slice of u-wind (real).
243! wg * ug grid slice of gathered values of u.
244! i/o * utg grid slice of u-wind tendency (real).
245! i/o * v grid slice of v-wind (real).
246! w * va work array re-used by called subroutines.
247! wg * vg grid slice of gathered values of v.
248! i/o * vtg grid slice of v-wind tendency (real).
249! i * w grid slice of diagnosed large-scale vertical velocity.
250! w * z grid slice of ambient mid-layer height in metres.
251! w * zf grid slice of ambient interface height in metres.
252! wg * zfg grid slice of gathered values of zf.
253! wg * zg grid slice of gathered values of z.

505718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
506 pblt(i) = pver
507 dsubcld(i) = 0._r8
508
509 jctop(i) = pver
510 jcbot(i) = 1
511
512 end do
513
5145324853248 if (zm_org) then
515! compute vertical average here
51600 orgavg(:) = 0._r8
51700 dptot(:) = 0._r8
518
51900 do k = 1, pver
52000 do i = 1,ncol
52100 if (org(i,k) .gt. 0) then
52200 orgavg(i) = orgavg(i)+dpp(i,k)*org(i,k)
523 dptot(i) = dptot(i)+dpp(i,k)
524 endif
525 enddo
526 enddo
527
52800 do i = 1,ncol
52900 if (dptot(i) .gt. 0) then
53000 orgavg(i) = orgavg(i)/dptot(i)
531 endif
532 enddo
533
53400 do k = 1, pver
53500 do i = 1, ncol
536 org2d(i,k) = orgavg(i)
537 enddo
538 enddo
539
540 endif
541
542!
543! calculate local pressure (mbs) and height (m) for both interface
544! and mid-layer locations.
545!
546718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
547 zs(i) = geos(i)*rgrav
548 pf(i,pver+1) = paph(i,pver+1)*0.01_r8
549 zf(i,pver+1) = zi(i,pver+1) + zs(i)
550 end do
55115974401650688 do k = 1,pver
5522156856023166000 do i = 1,ncol
553 p(i,k) = pap(i,k)*0.01_r8
554 pf(i,k) = paph(i,k)*0.01_r8
555 z(i,k) = zm(i,k) + zs(i)
556 zf(i,k) = zi(i,k) + zs(i)
557 end do
558 end do
559!
56013312001384448 do k = pver - 1,msg + 1,-1
5611797380019305000 do i = 1,ncol
5621797380018514915 if (abs(z(i,k)-zs(i)-pblh(i)) < (zf(i,k)-zf(i,k+1))*0.5_r8) pblt(i) = k
563 end do
564 end do
565!
566! store incoming specific humidity field for subsequent calculation
567! of precipitation (through change in storage).
568! define dry static energy (normalized by cp).
569!
57015974401650688 do k = 1,pver
5712156856023166000 do i = 1,ncol
572 q(i,k) = qh(i,k)
573 s(i,k) = t(i,k) + (grav/cpres)*z(i,k)
574 tp(i,k)=0.0_r8
575 shat(i,k) = s(i,k)
576 qhat(i,k) = q(i,k)
577 end do
578 end do
579
580718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
581 capeg(i) = 0._r8
582 lclg(i) = 1
583 lelg(i) = pver
584 maxg(i) = 1
585 tlg(i) = 400._r8
586 dsubcld(i) = 0._r8
587 end do
588
58953248106496 if( cam_physpkg_is('cam3')) then
590
591 ! For cam3 physics package, call non-dilute
592
59300 call buoyan(lchnk ,ncol , &
594 q ,t ,p ,z ,pf , &
595 tp ,qstp ,tl ,rl ,cape , &
596 pblt ,lcl ,lel ,lon ,maxi , &
597 rgas ,grav ,cpres ,msg , &
598 tpert )
599 else
600
601 ! Evaluate Tparcel, qs(Tparcel), buoyancy and CAPE,
602 ! lcl, lel, parcel launch level at index maxi()=hmax
603
6045324853248 call buoyan_dilute(lchnk ,ncol , &
605 q ,t ,p ,z ,pf , &
606 tp ,qstp ,tl ,rl ,cape , &
607 pblt ,lcl ,lel ,lon ,maxi , &
608 rgas ,grav ,cpres ,msg , &
609 tpert , org2d , landfrac)
610 end if
611
612!
613! determine whether grid points will undergo some deep convection
614! (ideep=1) or not (ideep=0), based on values of cape,lcl,lel
615! (require cape.gt. 0 and lel<lcl as minimum conditions).
616!
6175324853248 lengath = 0
618718952718952 do i=1,ncol
619718952718952 if (cape(i) > capelmt) then
620224859224859 lengath = lengath + 1
621 index(lengath) = i
622 end if
623 end do
624
6255324853248 if (lengath.eq.0) return
626224859277555 do ii=1,lengath
627 i=index(ii)
628 ideep(ii)=i
629 end do
630!
631! obtain gathered arrays necessary for ensuing calculations.
632!
63315808801633576 do k = 1,pver
63467457708326650 do i = 1,lengath
635 dp(i,k) = 0.01_r8*dpp(ideep(i),k)
636 qg(i,k) = q(ideep(i),k)
637 tg(i,k) = t(ideep(i),k)
638 pg(i,k) = p(ideep(i),k)
639 zg(i,k) = z(ideep(i),k)
640 sg(i,k) = s(ideep(i),k)
641 tpg(i,k) = tp(ideep(i),k)
642 zfg(i,k) = zf(ideep(i),k)
643 qstpg(i,k) = qstp(ideep(i),k)
644 ug(i,k) = 0._r8
645 vg(i,k) = 0._r8
646 end do
647 end do
648!
649224859277555 do i = 1,lengath
650 zfg(i,pver+1) = zf(ideep(i),pver+1)
651 end do
652224859277555 do i = 1,lengath
653 capeg(i) = cape(ideep(i))
654 lclg(i) = lcl(ideep(i))
655 lelg(i) = lel(ideep(i))
656 maxg(i) = maxi(ideep(i))
657 tlg(i) = tl(ideep(i))
658 landfracg(i) = landfrac(ideep(i))
659 end do
660!
661! calculate sub-cloud layer pressure "thickness" for use in
662! closure and tendency routines.
663!
66413700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
66558463347216430 do i = 1,lengath
66658463345846334 if (k >= maxg(i)) then
667237082237082 dsubcld(i) = dsubcld(i) + dp(i,k)
668 end if
669 end do
670 end do
671!
672! define array of factors (alpha) which defines interfacial
673! values, as well as interfacial values for (q,s) used in
674! subsequent routines.
675!
67613174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
67756214756938875 do i = 1,lengath
678! alpha(i,k) = 0.5
67956214755621475 sdifr = 0._r8
680 qdifr = 0._r8
68100 if (sg(i,k) > 0._r8 .or. sg(i,k-1) > 0._r8) &
68256214755621475 sdifr = abs((sg(i,k)-sg(i,k-1))/max(sg(i,k-1),sg(i,k)))
68356214755621475 if (qg(i,k) > 0._r8 .or. qg(i,k-1) > 0._r8) &
68456214755621475 qdifr = abs((qg(i,k)-qg(i,k-1))/max(qg(i,k-1),qg(i,k)))
68556214755621475 if (sdifr > 1.E-6_r8) then
686561809811236196 shat(i,k) = log(sg(i,k-1)/sg(i,k))*sg(i,k-1)*sg(i,k)/(sg(i,k-1)-sg(i,k))
687 else
68833773377 shat(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (sg(i,k)+sg(i,k-1))
689 end if
69056214755621475 if (qdifr > 1.E-6_r8) then
691562145711242914 qhat(i,k) = log(qg(i,k-1)/qg(i,k))*qg(i,k-1)*qg(i,k)/(qg(i,k-1)-qg(i,k))
692 else
6931818 qhat(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (qg(i,k)+qg(i,k-1))
694 end if
695 end do
696 end do
697!
698! obtain cloud properties.
699!
700
7015269652696 call cldprp(lchnk , &
702 qg ,tg ,ug ,vg ,pg , &
703 zg ,sg ,mu ,eu ,du , &
704 md ,ed ,sd ,qd ,mc , &
705 qu ,su ,zfg ,qs ,hmn , &
706 hsat ,shat ,qlg , &
707 cmeg ,maxg ,lelg ,jt ,jlcl , &
708 maxg ,j0 ,jd ,rl ,lengath , &
709 rgas ,grav ,cpres ,msg , &
710 pflxg ,evpg ,cug ,rprdg ,limcnv , &
711 tug ,tdg ,dz ,rppe ,eps0 , &
712 qsthat ,hsthat ,wtmu ,wtdu , &
713 wteu ,wted ,done, wtmd ,wtevp ,qds,c0mask,landfracg)
714
715!Needed for water tracers:
7162529408030142112wtcu(:,:) = cug(:,:)
7172529408030142112wtrpd(:,:) = rprdg(:,:)
718
719!
720! convert detrainment from units of "1/m" to "1/mb".
721!
722
72313700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
72458463347216430 do i = 1,lengath
725 du (i,k) = du (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
726 eu (i,k) = eu (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
727 ed (i,k) = ed (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
728 cug (i,k) = cug (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
729 cmeg (i,k) = cmeg (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
730 rprdg(i,k) = rprdg(i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
731 evpg (i,k) = evpg (i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
732 !Water tracers:
733 rppe(i,k) = rppe(i,k)* (zfg(i,k)-zfg(i,k+1))/dp(i,k)
734 end do
735 end do
736
7375269652696 call closure(lchnk , &
738 qg ,tg ,pg ,zg ,sg , &
739 tpg ,qs ,qu ,su ,mc , &
740 du ,mu ,md ,qd ,sd , &
741 qhat ,shat ,dp ,qstpg ,zfg , &
742 qlg ,dsubcld ,mb ,capeg ,tlg , &
743 lclg ,lelg ,jt ,maxg ,1 , &
744 lengath ,rgas ,grav ,cpres ,rl , &
745 msg ,capelmt )
746!
747! limit cloud base mass flux to theoretical upper bound.
748!
749224859277555 do i=1,lengath
750 mumax(i) = 0
751 end do
75213174001370096 do k=msg + 2,pver
75356214756938875 do i=1,lengath
754 mumax(i) = max(mumax(i), mu(i,k)/dp(i,k))
755 end do
756 end do
757
758224859277555 do i=1,lengath
759224859224859 if (mumax(i) > 0._r8) then
760222498222498 mb(i) = min(mb(i),0.5_r8/(delt*mumax(i)))
761 else
76223612361 mb(i) = 0._r8
763 endif
764 end do
765 ! If no_deep_pbl = .true., don't allow convection entirely
766 ! within PBL (suggestion of Bjorn Stevens, 8-2000)
767
7685269652696 if (no_deep_pbl) then
769224859277555 do i=1,lengath
770224859225644 if (zm(ideep(i),jt(i)) < pblh(ideep(i))) mb(i) = 0
771 end do
772 end if
773
77413700961422792 do k=msg+1,pver
77558463347216430 do i=1,lengath
776 mu (i,k) = mu (i,k)*mb(i)
777 md (i,k) = md (i,k)*mb(i)
778 mc (i,k) = mc (i,k)*mb(i)
779 du (i,k) = du (i,k)*mb(i)
780 eu (i,k) = eu (i,k)*mb(i)
781 ed (i,k) = ed (i,k)*mb(i)
782 cmeg (i,k) = cmeg (i,k)*mb(i)
783 rprdg(i,k) = rprdg(i,k)*mb(i)
784 cug (i,k) = cug (i,k)*mb(i)
785 evpg (i,k) = evpg (i,k)*mb(i)
786 pflxg(i,k+1)= pflxg(i,k+1)*mb(i)*100._r8/grav
787 !water tracers:
788 rppe(i,k) = rppe(i,k)*mb(i)
789 end do
790 end do
791!
792! compute temperature and moisture changes due to convection.
793!
7945269652696 call q1q2_pjr(lchnk , &
795 dqdt ,dsdt ,qg ,qs ,qu , &
796 su ,du ,qhat ,shat ,dp , &
797 mu ,md ,sd ,qd ,qlg , &
798 dsubcld ,jt ,maxg ,1 ,lengath , &
799 cpres ,rl ,msg , &
800 dlg ,evpg ,cug )
801
802
803!
804! gather back temperature and mixing ratio.
805!
806
80713700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
808!DIR$ CONCURRENT
80958463347216430 do i = 1,lengath
810!
811! q is updated to compute net precip.
812!
813 q(ideep(i),k) = qh(ideep(i),k) + 2._r8*delt*dqdt(i,k)
814 qtnd(ideep(i),k) = dqdt (i,k)
815 cme (ideep(i),k) = cmeg (i,k)
816 rprd(ideep(i),k) = rprdg(i,k)
817 zdu (ideep(i),k) = du (i,k)
818 mcon(ideep(i),k) = mc (i,k)
819 heat(ideep(i),k) = dsdt (i,k)*cpres
820 dlf (ideep(i),k) = dlg (i,k)
821 cu(ideep(i),k) = cug(i,k)
822 evp(ideep(i),k) = evpg(i,k)
823 tu(ideep(i),k) = tug(i,k)
824 td(ideep(i),k) = tdg(i,k)
825 pflx(ideep(i),k) = pflxg(i,k)
826 ql (ideep(i),k) = qlg (i,k)
827 end do
828 end do
829!
830!DIR$ CONCURRENT
831224859277555 do i = 1,lengath
832 jctop(ideep(i)) = jt(i)
833!++bee
834 jcbot(ideep(i)) = maxg(i)
835!--bee
836 pflx(ideep(i),pverp) = pflxg(i,pverp)
837 end do
838
839! Compute precip by integrating change in water vapor minus detrained cloud water
84013700961422792 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
8411849863619868732 do i = 1,ncol
842 prec(i) = prec(i) - dpp(i,k)* (q(i,k)-qh(i,k)) - dpp(i,k)*dlf(i,k)*2*delt
843 end do
844 end do
845
846! obtain final precipitation rate in m/s.
847711486764182 do i = 1,ncol
848 prec(i) = rgrav*max(prec(i),0._r8)/ (2._r8*delt)/1000._r8
849 end do
850
851! Compute reserved liquid (not yet in cldliq) for energy integrals.
852! Treat rliq as flux out bottom, to be added back later.
85315808801633576 do k = 1, pver
8542134458022925460 do i = 1, ncol
855 rliq(i) = rliq(i) + dlf(i,k)*dpp(i,k)/gravit
856 end do
857 end do
858711486816878 rliq(:ncol) = rliq(:ncol) /1000._r8
859
860 return
8615324853248end subroutine zm_convr
862
863!===============================================================================
8645324853248subroutine zm_conv_evap(ncol,lchnk, &
865 t,pmid,pdel,q, &
866 landfrac, &
867 tend_s, tend_s_snwprd, tend_s_snwevmlt, tend_q, &
868 prdprec, cldfrc, deltat, prec, snow, &
869 evpstore, substore, ntprprd, ntsnprd, flxprec, flxsnow )
870
871!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
872! Compute tendencies due to evaporation of rain from ZM scheme
873!--
874! Compute the total precipitation and snow fluxes at the surface.
875! Add in the latent heat of fusion for snow formation and melt, since it not dealt with
876! in the Zhang-MacFarlane parameterization.
877! Evaporate some of the precip directly into the environment using a Sundqvist type algorithm
878!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
879
880 use wv_saturation, only: qsat
881 use phys_grid, only: get_rlat_all_p
882
883!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
884 integer,intent(in) :: ncol, lchnk ! number of columns and chunk index
885 real(r8),intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: t ! temperature (K)
886 real(r8),intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: pmid ! midpoint pressure (Pa)
887 real(r8),intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: pdel ! layer thickness (Pa)
888 real(r8),intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: q ! water vapor (kg/kg)
889 real(r8),intent(in), dimension(pcols) :: landfrac
890 real(r8),intent(inout), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tend_s ! heating rate (J/kg/s)
891 real(r8),intent(inout), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tend_q ! water vapor tendency (kg/kg/s)
892 real(r8),intent(out ), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tend_s_snwprd ! Heating rate of snow production
893 real(r8),intent(out ), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tend_s_snwevmlt ! Heating rate of evap/melting of snow
894
895
896
897 real(r8), intent(in ) :: prdprec(pcols,pver)! precipitation production (kg/ks/s)
898 real(r8), intent(in ) :: cldfrc(pcols,pver) ! cloud fraction
899 real(r8), intent(in ) :: deltat ! time step
900
901 real(r8), intent(inout) :: prec(pcols) ! Convective-scale preciptn rate
902 real(r8), intent(out) :: snow(pcols) ! Convective-scale snowfall rate
903!
904!---------------------------Local storage-------------------------------
905
906 real(r8) :: es (pcols,pver) ! Saturation vapor pressure
907 real(r8) :: fice (pcols,pver) ! ice fraction in precip production
908 real(r8) :: fsnow_conv(pcols,pver) ! snow fraction in precip production
909 real(r8) :: qs (pcols,pver) ! saturation specific humidity
910 real(r8),intent(out) :: flxprec(pcols,pverp) ! Convective-scale flux of precip at interfaces (kg/m2/s)
911 real(r8),intent(out) :: flxsnow(pcols,pverp) ! Convective-scale flux of snow at interfaces (kg/m2/s)
912 real(r8),intent(out) :: ntprprd(pcols,pver) ! net precip production in layer
913 real(r8),intent(out) :: ntsnprd(pcols,pver) ! net snow production in layer
914
915 !Needed for water tracers:
916 real(r8), intent(out) :: evpstore(pcols,pver) !preciptation evaporation
917 real(r8), intent(out) :: substore(pcols,pver) !snow sublimation
918
919 real(r8) :: work1 ! temp variable (pjr)
920 real(r8) :: work2 ! temp variable (pjr)
921
922 real(r8) :: evpvint(pcols) ! vertical integral of evaporation
923 real(r8) :: evpprec(pcols) ! evaporation of precipitation (kg/kg/s)
924 real(r8) :: evpsnow(pcols) ! evaporation of snowfall (kg/kg/s)
925 real(r8) :: snowmlt(pcols) ! snow melt tendency in layer
926 real(r8) :: flxsntm(pcols) ! flux of snow into layer, after melting
927
928 real(r8) :: kemask
929 real(r8) :: evplimit ! temp variable for evaporation limits
930 real(r8) :: rlat(pcols)
931
932 integer :: i,k ! longitude,level indices
933
934
935!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
936
937! convert input precip to kg/m2/s
938718952825448 prec(:ncol) = prec(:ncol)*1000._r8
939
940! determine saturation vapor pressure
9412156856048035936 call qsat(t(1:ncol, 1:pver), pmid(1:ncol, 1:pver), &
942 es(1:ncol, 1:pver), qs(1:ncol, 1:pver))
943
944! determine ice fraction in rain production (use cloud water parameterization fraction at present)
9455324853248 call cldfrc_fice(ncol, t, fice, fsnow_conv)
946
947! zero the flux integrals on the top boundary
948718952825448 flxprec(:ncol,1) = 0._r8
949718952825448 flxsnow(:ncol,1) = 0._r8
950718952825448 evpvint(:ncol) = 0._r8
951
952!Zero water tracer variables (JN):
9532555904030457856 evpstore(:,:) = 0._r8
9542555904030457856 substore(:,:) = 0._r8
955
95615974401650688 do k = 1, pver
9572156856023166000 do i = 1, ncol
958
959! Melt snow falling into layer, if necessary.
9602156856021568560 if (t(i,k) > tmelt) then
96153571205357120 flxsntm(i) = 0._r8
962 snowmlt(i) = flxsnow(i,k) * gravit/ pdel(i,k)
963 else
9641621144016211440 flxsntm(i) = flxsnow(i,k)
965 snowmlt(i) = 0._r8
966 end if
967
968! relative humidity depression must be > 0 for evaporation
9692156856021568560 evplimit = max(1._r8 - q(i,k)/qs(i,k), 0._r8)
970
971 if (zm_org) then
97200 kemask = ke * (1._r8 - landfrac(i)) + ke_lnd * landfrac(i)
973 else
9742156856021568560 kemask = ke
975 endif
976
977! total evaporation depends on flux in the top of the layer
978! flux prec is the net production above layer minus evaporation into environmet
9792156856021568560 evpprec(i) = kemask * (1._r8 - cldfrc(i,k)) * evplimit * sqrt(flxprec(i,k))
980!**********************************************************
981!! evpprec(i) = 0. ! turn off evaporation for now
982!**********************************************************
983
984! Don't let evaporation supersaturate layer (approx). Layer may already be saturated.
985! Currently does not include heating/cooling change to qs
986 evplimit = max(0._r8, (qs(i,k)-q(i,k)) / deltat)
987
988! Don't evaporate more than is falling into the layer - do not evaporate rain formed
989! in this layer but if precip production is negative, remove from the available precip
990! Negative precip production occurs because of evaporation in downdrafts.
991!!$ evplimit = flxprec(i,k) * gravit / pdel(i,k) + min(prdprec(i,k), 0.)
992 evplimit = min(evplimit, flxprec(i,k) * gravit / pdel(i,k))
993
994! Total evaporation cannot exceed input precipitation
995 evplimit = min(evplimit, (prec(i) - evpvint(i)) * gravit / pdel(i,k))
996
997 evpprec(i) = min(evplimit, evpprec(i))
998
999! evaporation of snow depends on snow fraction of total precipitation in the top after melting
1000 if (flxprec(i,k) > 0._r8) then
1001! evpsnow(i) = evpprec(i) * flxsntm(i) / flxprec(i,k)
1002! prevent roundoff problems
100319443711944371 work1 = min(max(0._r8,flxsntm(i)/flxprec(i,k)),1._r8)
1004 evpsnow(i) = evpprec(i) * work1
1005 else
10061962418919624189 evpsnow(i) = 0._r8
1007 end if
1008
1009!
1010! Save the evaporative flux for water tracers
1011!
10122156856021568560 evpstore(i,k) = evpprec(i)
1013 substore(i,k) = evpsnow(i)
1014
1015! vertically integrated evaporation
1016 evpvint(i) = evpvint(i) + evpprec(i) * pdel(i,k)/gravit
1017
1018! net precip production is production - evaporation
1019 ntprprd(i,k) = prdprec(i,k) - evpprec(i)
1020! net snow production is precip production * ice fraction - evaporation - melting
1021!pjrworks ntsnprd(i,k) = prdprec(i,k)*fice(i,k) - evpsnow(i) - snowmlt(i)
1022!pjrwrks2 ntsnprd(i,k) = prdprec(i,k)*fsnow_conv(i,k) - evpsnow(i) - snowmlt(i)
1023! the small amount added to flxprec in the work1 expression has been increased from
1024! 1e-36 to 8.64e-11 (1e-5 mm/day). This causes the temperature based partitioning
1025! scheme to be used for small flxprec amounts. This is to address error growth problems.
1026#ifdef PERGRO
1027 work1 = min(max(0._r8,flxsnow(i,k)/(flxprec(i,k)+8.64e-11_r8)),1._r8)
1028#else
1029 if (flxprec(i,k).gt.0._r8) then
103019443711944371 work1 = min(max(0._r8,flxsnow(i,k)/flxprec(i,k)),1._r8)
1031 else
10321962418919624189 work1 = 0._r8
1033 endif
1034#endif
10352156856021568560 work2 = max(fsnow_conv(i,k), work1)
1036104277104277 if (snowmlt(i).gt.0._r8) work2 = 0._r8
1037! work2 = fsnow_conv(i,k)
1038 ntsnprd(i,k) = prdprec(i,k)*work2 - evpsnow(i) - snowmlt(i)
1039 tend_s_snwprd (i,k) = prdprec(i,k)*work2*latice
1040 tend_s_snwevmlt(i,k) = - ( evpsnow(i) + snowmlt(i) )*latice
1041
1042! precipitation fluxes
1043 flxprec(i,k+1) = flxprec(i,k) + ntprprd(i,k) * pdel(i,k)/gravit
1044 flxsnow(i,k+1) = flxsnow(i,k) + ntsnprd(i,k) * pdel(i,k)/gravit
1045
1046! protect against rounding error
1047 flxprec(i,k+1) = max(flxprec(i,k+1), 0._r8)
1048 flxsnow(i,k+1) = max(flxsnow(i,k+1), 0._r8)
1049! more protection (pjr)
1050! flxsnow(i,k+1) = min(flxsnow(i,k+1), flxprec(i,k+1))
1051
1052! heating (cooling) and moistening due to evaporation
1053! - latent heat of vaporization for precip production has already been accounted for
1054! - snow is contained in prec
1055 tend_s(i,k) =-evpprec(i)*latvap + ntsnprd(i,k)*latice
1056 tend_q(i,k) = evpprec(i)
1057 end do
1058 end do
1059
1060! set output precipitation rates (m/s)
1061718952825448 prec(:ncol) = flxprec(:ncol,pver+1) / 1000._r8
1062718952825448 snow(:ncol) = flxsnow(:ncol,pver+1) / 1000._r8
1063
1064!**********************************************************
1065!!$ tend_s(:ncol,:) = 0. ! turn heating off
1066!**********************************************************
1067
10685324853248 end subroutine zm_conv_evap
1069
1070
1071
1072106496106496subroutine convtran(lchnk , &
1073 doconvtran,q ,ncnst ,mu ,md , &
1074 du ,eu ,ed ,dp ,dsubcld , &
1075 jt ,mx ,ideep ,il1g ,il2g , &
1076 nstep ,fracis ,dqdt ,dpdry, Rwt )
1077!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1078!
1079! Purpose:
1080! Convective transport of trace species
1081!
1082! Mixing ratios may be with respect to either dry or moist air
1083!
1084! Method:
1085! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
1086! <Also include any applicable external references.>
1087!
1088! Author: P. Rasch
1089!
1090! Rwt added by J. Nusbaumer to fix mystery variable passing error
1091!
1092!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1093 use shr_kind_mod, only: r8 => shr_kind_r8
1094 use constituents, only: cnst_get_type_byind
1095 use ppgrid
1096
1097 !Needed for water tracers?
1098 use water_tracer_vars, only: wtrc_iatype, wtrc_ntype, iwspec
1099 use water_tracer_vars, only: trace_water
1100 use water_tracers, only: wtrc_ratio
1101 use water_types, only: iwtliq, iwtice
1102
1103 implicit none
1104!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1105!
1106! Input arguments
1107!
1108 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
1109 integer, intent(in) :: ncnst ! number of tracers to transport
1110 logical, intent(in) :: doconvtran(ncnst) ! flag for doing convective transport
1111 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Tracer array including moisture
1112 real(r8), intent(in) :: mu(pcols,pver) ! Mass flux up
1113 real(r8), intent(in) :: md(pcols,pver) ! Mass flux down
1114 real(r8), intent(in) :: du(pcols,pver) ! Mass detraining from updraft
1115 real(r8), intent(in) :: eu(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from updraft
1116 real(r8), intent(in) :: ed(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from downdraft
1117 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(pcols,pver) ! Delta pressure between interfaces
1118 real(r8), intent(in) :: dsubcld(pcols) ! Delta pressure from cloud base to sfc
1119 real(r8), intent(in) :: fracis(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! fraction of tracer that is insoluble
1120
1121 integer, intent(in) :: jt(pcols) ! Index of cloud top for each column
1122 integer, intent(in) :: mx(pcols) ! Index of cloud top for each column
1123 integer, intent(in) :: ideep(pcols) ! Gathering array
1124 integer, intent(in) :: il1g ! Gathered min lon indices over which to operate
1125 integer, intent(in) :: il2g ! Gathered max lon indices over which to operate
1126 integer, intent(in) :: nstep ! Time step index
1127
1128 real(r8), intent(in) :: dpdry(pcols,pver) ! Delta pressure between interfaces
1129
1130
1131! input/output
1132
1133 real(r8), intent(out) :: dqdt(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Tracer tendency array
1134
1135!water tracers:
1136 !NOTE: the 2 at the end is for liquid and ice - JN
1137 real(r8), intent(out) :: Rwt(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtice),2) !water tracer ratio
1138
1139!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
1140
1141 integer i ! Work index
1142 integer k ! Work index
1143 integer kbm ! Highest altitude index of cloud base
1144 integer kk ! Work index
1145 integer kkp1 ! Work index
1146 integer km1 ! Work index
1147 integer kp1 ! Work index
1148 integer ktm ! Highest altitude index of cloud top
1149 integer m ! Work index
1150
1151 real(r8) cabv ! Mix ratio of constituent above
1152 real(r8) cbel ! Mix ratio of constituent below
1153 real(r8) cdifr ! Normalized diff between cabv and cbel
1154 real(r8) chat(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in env at interfaces
1155 real(r8) cond(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in downdraft at interfaces
1156 real(r8) const(pcols,pver) ! Gathered tracer array
1157 real(r8) fisg(pcols,pver) ! gathered insoluble fraction of tracer
1158 real(r8) conu(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in updraft at interfaces
1159 real(r8) dcondt(pcols,pver) ! Gathered tend array
1160 real(r8) small ! A small number
1161 real(r8) mbsth ! Threshold for mass fluxes
1162 real(r8) mupdudp ! A work variable
1163 real(r8) minc ! A work variable
1164 real(r8) maxc ! A work variable
1165 real(r8) fluxin ! A work variable
1166 real(r8) fluxout ! A work variable
1167 real(r8) netflux ! A work variable
1168
1169 real(r8) dutmp(pcols,pver) ! Mass detraining from updraft
1170 real(r8) eutmp(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from updraft
1171 real(r8) edtmp(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from downdraft
1172 real(r8) dptmp(pcols,pver) ! Delta pressure between interfaces
1173
1174 !Water tracers?
1175 real(r8) chtmp(pcols,pver) !Use for debugging...
1176
1177!NOTE: ixcldice = 3 - JN
1178
1179!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1180!
1181 small = 1.e-36_r8
1182! mbsth is the threshold below which we treat the mass fluxes as zero (in mb/s)
1183 mbsth = 1.e-15_r8
1184
1185! Find the highest level top and bottom levels of convection
1186 ktm = pver
1187 kbm = pver
1188449718449718 do i = il1g, il2g
1189 ktm = min(ktm,jt(i))
1190 kbm = min(kbm,mx(i))
1191 end do
1192
1193! Loop ever each constituent
119459637766070272 do m = 2, ncnst
119559637765963776 if (doconvtran(m)) then
1196
119719169283833856 if (cnst_get_type_byind(m).eq.'dry') then
11983194880033013760 do k = 1,pver
1199134915400166864200 do i =il1g,il2g
1200 dptmp(i,k) = dpdry(i,k)
1201 dutmp(i,k) = du(i,k)*dp(i,k)/dpdry(i,k)
1202 eutmp(i,k) = eu(i,k)*dp(i,k)/dpdry(i,k)
1203 edtmp(i,k) = ed(i,k)*dp(i,k)/dpdry(i,k)
1204 end do
1205 end do
1206 else
12072555904026411008 do k = 1,pver
1208107932320133491360 do i =il1g,il2g
1209 dptmp(i,k) = dp(i,k)
1210 dutmp(i,k) = du(i,k)
1211 eutmp(i,k) = eu(i,k)
1212 edtmp(i,k) = ed(i,k)
1213 end do
1214 end do
1215 endif
1216! dptmp = dp
1217
1218! Gather up the constituent and set tend to zero
12195750784059424768 do k = 1,pver
1220242847720300355560 do i =il1g,il2g
1221 const(i,k) = q(ideep(i),k,m)
1222 fisg(i,k) = fracis(ideep(i),k,m)
1223 end do
1224 end do
1225
1226! From now on work only with gathered data
1227
1228! Interpolate environment tracer values to interfaces
12295750784059424768 do k = 1,pver
12305750784057507840 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1231242847720242847720 do i = il1g, il2g
1232242847720242847720 minc = min(const(i,km1),const(i,k))
1233 maxc = max(const(i,km1),const(i,k))
1234 if (minc < 0) then
123500 cdifr = 0._r8
1236 else
1237242847720242847720 cdifr = abs(const(i,k)-const(i,km1))/max(maxc,small)
1238 endif
1239
1240! If the two layers differ significantly use a geometric averaging
1241! procedure
1242242847720242847720 if (cdifr > 1.E-6_r8) then
1243191792552191792552 cabv = max(const(i,km1),maxc*1.e-12_r8)
1244 cbel = max(const(i,k),maxc*1.e-12_r8)
1245191792552383585104 chat(i,k) = log(cabv/cbel)/(cabv-cbel)*cabv*cbel
1246
1247 else ! Small diff, so just arithmetic mean
12485105516851055168 chat(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (const(i,k)+const(i,km1))
1249 end if
1250
1251! Provisional up and down draft values
1252 conu(i,k) = chat(i,k)
1253 cond(i,k) = chat(i,k)
1254
1255! provisional tends
1256 dcondt(i,k) = 0._r8
1257
1258 end do
1259 end do
1260
1261!Delete:
1262! if(m .eq. 3) then
1263! chtmp(:,:) = chat(i,k)
1264! end if
1265
1266! if(m .eq. wtrc_iatype(3,iwtice)) then
1267! write(iulog,*) 'chat ice 3 diff',sum(4._r8*chat(:il2g,:)-chtmp(:il2g,:))
1268! end if
1269
1270! Do levels adjacent to top and bottom
127119169281916928 k = 2
1272 km1 = 1
1273 kk = pver
127480949248094924 do i = il1g,il2g
127580949248094924 mupdudp = mu(i,kk) + dutmp(i,kk)*dptmp(i,kk)
1276 if (mupdudp > mbsth) then
127774437207443720 conu(i,kk) = (+eutmp(i,kk)*fisg(i,kk)*const(i,kk)*dptmp(i,kk))/mupdudp
1278 endif
127980949248094924 if (md(i,k) < -mbsth) then
128000 cond(i,k) = (-edtmp(i,km1)*fisg(i,km1)*const(i,km1)*dptmp(i,km1))/md(i,k)
1281 endif
1282 end do
1283
1284! Updraft from bottom to top
12855559091257507840 do kk = pver-1,1,-1
12865559091255590912 kkp1 = min(pver,kk+1)
1287234752796234752796 do i = il1g,il2g
1288234752796234752796 mupdudp = mu(i,kk) + dutmp(i,kk)*dptmp(i,kk)
1289 if (mupdudp > mbsth) then
12907767165677671656 conu(i,kk) = ( mu(i,kkp1)*conu(i,kkp1)+eutmp(i,kk)*fisg(i,kk)* &
1291 const(i,kk)*dptmp(i,kk) )/mupdudp
1292 endif
1293 end do
1294 end do
1295
1296! Downdraft from top to bottom
12975367398455590912 do k = 3,pver
12985367398453673984 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1299226657872226657872 do i = il1g,il2g
1300226657872226657872 if (md(i,k) < -mbsth) then
13016819148868191488 cond(i,k) = ( md(i,km1)*cond(i,km1)-edtmp(i,km1)*fisg(i,km1)*const(i,km1) &
1302 *dptmp(i,km1) )/md(i,k)
1303 endif
1304 end do
1305 end do
1306
1307
13082560532427522252 do k = ktm,pver
13092560532425605324 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1310 kp1 = min(pver,k+1)
1311112452876112452876 do i = il1g,il2g
1312
1313! version 1 hard to check for roundoff errors
1314! dcondt(i,k) =
1315! $ +(+mu(i,kp1)* (conu(i,kp1)-chat(i,kp1))
1316! $ -mu(i,k)* (conu(i,k)-chat(i,k))
1317! $ +md(i,kp1)* (cond(i,kp1)-chat(i,kp1))
1318! $ -md(i,k)* (cond(i,k)-chat(i,k))
1319! $ )/dp(i,k)
1320
1321! version 2 hard to limit fluxes
1322! fluxin = mu(i,kp1)*conu(i,kp1) + mu(i,k)*chat(i,k)
1323! $ -(md(i,k) *cond(i,k) + md(i,kp1)*chat(i,kp1))
1324! fluxout = mu(i,k)*conu(i,k) + mu(i,kp1)*chat(i,kp1)
1325! $ -(md(i,kp1)*cond(i,kp1) + md(i,k)*chat(i,k))
1326
1327! version 3 limit fluxes outside convection to mass in appropriate layer
1328! these limiters are probably only safe for positive definite quantitities
1329! it assumes that mu and md already satify a courant number limit of 1
1330112452876112452876 fluxin = mu(i,kp1)*conu(i,kp1)+ mu(i,k)*min(chat(i,k),const(i,km1)) &
1331 -(md(i,k) *cond(i,k) + md(i,kp1)*min(chat(i,kp1),const(i,kp1)))
1332 fluxout = mu(i,k)*conu(i,k) + mu(i,kp1)*min(chat(i,kp1),const(i,k)) &
1333 -(md(i,kp1)*cond(i,kp1) + md(i,k)*min(chat(i,k),const(i,k)))
1334
1335 netflux = fluxin - fluxout
1336 if (abs(netflux) < max(fluxin,fluxout)*1.e-12_r8) then
133776177227617722 netflux = 0._r8
1338 endif
1339 dcondt(i,k) = netflux/dptmp(i,k)
1340 end do
1341 end do
1342! %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
1343!
1344!DIR$ NOINTERCHANGE
134523315764248504 do k = kbm,pver
134623315762331576 km1 = max(1,k-1)
13471017550810175508 do i = il1g,il2g
13481017550810175508 if (k == mx(i)) then
1349
1350! version 1
1351! dcondt(i,k) = (1./dsubcld(i))*
1352! $ (-mu(i,k)*(conu(i,k)-chat(i,k))
1353! $ -md(i,k)*(cond(i,k)-chat(i,k))
1354! $ )
1355
1356! version 2
1357! fluxin = mu(i,k)*chat(i,k) - md(i,k)*cond(i,k)
1358! fluxout = mu(i,k)*conu(i,k) - md(i,k)*chat(i,k)
1359! version 3
136080949248094924 fluxin = mu(i,k)*min(chat(i,k),const(i,km1)) - md(i,k)*cond(i,k)
1361 fluxout = mu(i,k)*conu(i,k) - md(i,k)*min(chat(i,k),const(i,k))
1362
1363 netflux = fluxin - fluxout
1364 if (abs(netflux) < max(fluxin,fluxout)*1.e-12_r8) then
1365112806112806 netflux = 0._r8
1366 endif
1367! dcondt(i,k) = netflux/dsubcld(i)
136880949248094924 dcondt(i,k) = netflux/dptmp(i,k)
136920805842080584 else if (k > mx(i)) then
1370! dcondt(i,k) = dcondt(i,k-1)
1371440028440028 dcondt(i,k) = 0._r8
1372 end if
1373 end do
1374 end do
1375
1376! Initialize to zero everywhere, then scatter tendency back to full array
13779201254401096482816 dqdt(:,:,m) = 0._r8
13785750784059424768 do k = 1,pver
13795750784057507840 kp1 = min(pver,k+1)
1380!DIR$ CONCURRENT
1381242847720242847720 do i = il1g,il2g
1382 dqdt(ideep(i),k,m) = dcondt(i,k)
1383 end do
1384 end do
1385
1386 end if ! for doconvtran
1387
1388 end do
1389
1390106496106496 if ( trace_water )then
1391!Calculate the water tracer ratio:
1392408944640489029632Rwt(:,:,:,:) = 1._r8 !initalize ratio
1393106496106496if(doconvtran(wtrc_iatype(1,iwtliq))) then !are water tracers being transported?
1394159744212992 do m=2,wtrc_ntype(iwtliq) !loop over water tracers
139547923204952064 do k=1,pver
13962023731025029630 do i=il1g,il2g
13972023731040474620 Rwt(ideep(i),k,m,1) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)), &
1398 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)), &
1399 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtliq)))
14002023731020237310 Rwt(ideep(i),k,m,2) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)), &
1401 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)), &
1402 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtice)))
1403 end do
1404 end do
1405 end do
1406end if
1407 end if
1408
1409 return
1410106496106496end subroutine convtran
1411
1412!=========================================================================================
1413
141453248106496subroutine momtran(lchnk, ncol, &
1415 domomtran,q ,ncnst ,mu ,md , &
1416 du ,eu ,ed ,dp ,dsubcld , &
1417 jt ,mx ,ideep ,il1g ,il2g , &
1418 nstep ,dqdt ,pguall ,pgdall, icwu, icwd, dt, seten )
1419!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1420!
1421! Purpose:
1422! Convective transport of momentum
1423!
1424! Mixing ratios may be with respect to either dry or moist air
1425!
1426! Method:
1427! Based on the convtran subroutine by P. Rasch
1428! <Also include any applicable external references.>
1429!
1430! Author: J. Richter and P. Rasch
1431!
1432!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1433 use shr_kind_mod, only: r8 => shr_kind_r8
1434 use constituents, only: cnst_get_type_byind
1435 use ppgrid
1436
1437 implicit none
1438!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1439!
1440! Input arguments
1441!
1442 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
1443 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
1444 integer, intent(in) :: ncnst ! number of tracers to transport
1445 logical, intent(in) :: domomtran(ncnst) ! flag for doing convective transport
1446 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Wind array
1447 real(r8), intent(in) :: mu(pcols,pver) ! Mass flux up
1448 real(r8), intent(in) :: md(pcols,pver) ! Mass flux down
1449 real(r8), intent(in) :: du(pcols,pver) ! Mass detraining from updraft
1450 real(r8), intent(in) :: eu(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from updraft
1451 real(r8), intent(in) :: ed(pcols,pver) ! Mass entraining from downdraft
1452 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(pcols,pver) ! Delta pressure between interfaces
1453 real(r8), intent(in) :: dsubcld(pcols) ! Delta pressure from cloud base to sfc
1454 real(r8), intent(in) :: dt ! time step in seconds : 2*delta_t
1455
1456 integer, intent(in) :: jt(pcols) ! Index of cloud top for each column
1457 integer, intent(in) :: mx(pcols) ! Index of cloud top for each column
1458 integer, intent(in) :: ideep(pcols) ! Gathering array
1459 integer, intent(in) :: il1g ! Gathered min lon indices over which to operate
1460 integer, intent(in) :: il2g ! Gathered max lon indices over which to operate
1461 integer, intent(in) :: nstep ! Time step index
1462
1463
1464
1465! input/output
1466
1467 real(r8), intent(out) :: dqdt(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Tracer tendency array
1468
1469!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
1470
1471 integer i ! Work index
1472 integer k ! Work index
1473 integer kbm ! Highest altitude index of cloud base
1474 integer kk ! Work index
1475 integer kkp1 ! Work index
1476 integer kkm1 ! Work index
1477 integer km1 ! Work index
1478 integer kp1 ! Work index
1479 integer ktm ! Highest altitude index of cloud top
1480 integer m ! Work index
1481 integer ii ! Work index
1482
1483 real(r8) cabv ! Mix ratio of constituent above
1484 real(r8) cbel ! Mix ratio of constituent below
1485 real(r8) cdifr ! Normalized diff between cabv and cbel
1486 real(r8) chat(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in env at interfaces
1487 real(r8) cond(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in downdraft at interfaces
1488 real(r8) const(pcols,pver) ! Gathered wind array
1489 real(r8) conu(pcols,pver) ! Mix ratio in updraft at interfaces
1490 real(r8) dcondt(pcols,pver) ! Gathered tend array
1491 real(r8) small ! A small number
1492 real(r8) mbsth ! Threshold for mass fluxes
1493 real(r8) mupdudp ! A work variable
1494 real(r8) minc ! A work variable
1495 real(r8) maxc ! A work variable
1496 real(r8) fluxin ! A work variable
1497 real(r8) fluxout ! A work variable
1498 real(r8) netflux ! A work variable
1499
1500 real(r8) momcu ! constant for updraft pressure gradient term
1501 real(r8) momcd ! constant for downdraft pressure gradient term
1502 real(r8) sum ! sum
1503 real(r8) sum2 ! sum2
1504
1505 real(r8) mududp(pcols,pver) ! working variable
1506 real(r8) mddudp(pcols,pver) ! working variable
1507
1508 real(r8) pgu(pcols,pver) ! Pressure gradient term for updraft
1509 real(r8) pgd(pcols,pver) ! Pressure gradient term for downdraft
1510
1511 real(r8),intent(out) :: pguall(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Apparent force from updraft PG
1512 real(r8),intent(out) :: pgdall(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! Apparent force from downdraft PG
1513
1514 real(r8),intent(out) :: icwu(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! In-cloud winds in updraft
1515 real(r8),intent(out) :: icwd(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! In-cloud winds in downdraft
1516
1517 real(r8),intent(out) :: seten(pcols,pver) ! Dry static energy tendency
1518 real(r8) gseten(pcols,pver) ! Gathered dry static energy tendency
1519
1520 real(r8) mflux(pcols,pverp,ncnst) ! Gathered momentum flux
1521
1522 real(r8) wind0(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! gathered wind before time step
1523 real(r8) windf(pcols,pver,ncnst) ! gathered wind after time step
1524 real(r8) fkeb, fket, ketend_cons, ketend, utop, ubot, vtop, vbot, gset2
1525
1526
1527!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1528!
1529
1530! Initialize outgoing fields
15315111808061128704 pguall(:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
15325111808061128704 pgdall(:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
1533! Initialize in-cloud winds to environmental wind
15344313712053147744 icwu(:ncol,:,:) = q(:ncol,:,:)
15354313712053147744 icwd(:ncol,:,:) = q(:ncol,:,:)
1536
1537! Initialize momentum flux and final winds
15385282201663152128 mflux(:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
15395111808061128704 wind0(:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
15405111808061128704 windf(:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
1541
1542! Initialize dry static energy
1543
15442555904030457856 seten(:,:) = 0.0_r8
15452555904030457856 gseten(:,:) = 0.0_r8
1546
1547! Define constants for parameterization
1548
15495324853248 momcu = 0.4_r8
1550 momcd = 0.4_r8
1551
1552 small = 1.e-36_r8
1553! mbsth is the threshold below which we treat the mass fluxes as zero (in mb/s)
1554 mbsth = 1.e-15_r8
1555
1556! Find the highest level top and bottom levels of convection
1557 ktm = pver
1558 kbm = pver
1559224859224859 do i = il1g, il2g
1560 ktm = min(ktm,jt(i))
1561 kbm = min(kbm,mx(i))
1562 end do
1563
1564! Loop ever each wind component
1565106496159744 do m = 1, ncnst !start at m = 1 to transport momentum
1566106496106496 if (domomtran(m)) then
1567
1568! Gather up the winds and set tend to zero
156931948803301376 do k = 1,pver
15701349154016686420 do i =il1g,il2g
1571 const(i,k) = q(ideep(i),k,m)
1572 wind0(i,k,m) = const(i,k)
1573 end do
1574 end do
1575
1576
1577! From now on work only with gathered data
1578
1579! Interpolate winds to interfaces
1580
158131948803301376 do k = 1,pver
158231948803194880 km1 = max(1,k-1)
15831349154013491540 do i = il1g, il2g
1584
1585 ! use arithmetic mean
1586 chat(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (const(i,k)+const(i,km1))
1587
1588! Provisional up and down draft values
1589 conu(i,k) = chat(i,k)
1590 cond(i,k) = chat(i,k)
1591
1592! provisional tends
1593 dcondt(i,k) = 0._r8
1594
1595 end do
1596 end do
1597
1598
1599!
1600! Pressure Perturbation Term
1601!
1602
1603 !Top boundary: assume mu is zero
1604
1605106496106496 k=1
1606449718662710 pgu(:il2g,k) = 0.0_r8
1607449718662710 pgd(:il2g,k) = 0.0_r8
1608
160929818883088384 do k=2,pver-1
161029818882981888 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1611 kp1 = min(pver,k+1)
16121259210412592104 do i = il1g,il2g
1613
1614 !interior points
1615
1616 mududp(i,k) = ( mu(i,k) * (const(i,k)- const(i,km1))/dp(i,km1) &
1617 + mu(i,kp1) * (const(i,kp1) - const(i,k))/dp(i,k))
1618
1619 pgu(i,k) = - momcu * 0.5_r8 * mududp(i,k)
1620
1621
1622 mddudp(i,k) = ( md(i,k) * (const(i,k)- const(i,km1))/dp(i,km1) &
1623 + md(i,kp1) * (const(i,kp1) - const(i,k))/dp(i,k))
1624
1625 pgd(i,k) = - momcd * 0.5_r8 * mddudp(i,k)
1626
1627
1628 end do
1629 end do
1630
1631 ! bottom boundary
1632106496106496 k = pver
1633 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1634449718449718 do i=il1g,il2g
1635
1636 mududp(i,k) = mu(i,k) * (const(i,k)- const(i,km1))/dp(i,km1)
1637 pgu(i,k) = - momcu * mududp(i,k)
1638
1639 mddudp(i,k) = md(i,k) * (const(i,k)- const(i,km1))/dp(i,km1)
1640
1641 pgd(i,k) = - momcd * mddudp(i,k)
1642
1643 end do
1644
1645
1646!
1647! In-cloud velocity calculations
1648!
1649
1650! Do levels adjacent to top and bottom
1651106496106496 k = 2
1652 km1 = 1
1653 kk = pver
1654 kkm1 = max(1,kk-1)
1655449718449718 do i = il1g,il2g
1656449718449718 mupdudp = mu(i,kk) + du(i,kk)*dp(i,kk)
1657 if (mupdudp > mbsth) then
1658
1659413540413540 conu(i,kk) = (+eu(i,kk)*const(i,kk)*dp(i,kk)+pgu(i,kk)*dp(i,kk))/mupdudp
1660 endif
1661449718449718 if (md(i,k) < -mbsth) then
166200 cond(i,k) = (-ed(i,km1)*const(i,km1)*dp(i,km1))-pgd(i,km1)*dp(i,km1)/md(i,k)
1663 endif
1664
1665
1666 end do
1667
1668
1669
1670! Updraft from bottom to top
167130883843194880 do kk = pver-1,1,-1
167230883843088384 kkm1 = max(1,kk-1)
1673 kkp1 = min(pver,kk+1)
16741304182213041822 do i = il1g,il2g
16751304182213041822 mupdudp = mu(i,kk) + du(i,kk)*dp(i,kk)
1676 if (mupdudp > mbsth) then
1677
167843150924315092 conu(i,kk) = ( mu(i,kkp1)*conu(i,kkp1)+eu(i,kk)* &
1679 const(i,kk)*dp(i,kk)+pgu(i,kk)*dp(i,kk))/mupdudp
1680 endif
1681 end do
1682
1683 end do
1684
1685
1686! Downdraft from top to bottom
168729818883088384 do k = 3,pver
168829818882981888 km1 = max(1,k-1)
16891259210412592104 do i = il1g,il2g
16901259210412592104 if (md(i,k) < -mbsth) then
1691
169237884163788416 cond(i,k) = ( md(i,km1)*cond(i,km1)-ed(i,km1)*const(i,km1) &
1693 *dp(i,km1)-pgd(i,km1)*dp(i,km1) )/md(i,k)
1694
1695 endif
1696 end do
1697 end do
1698
1699
1700106496106496 sum = 0._r8
1701 sum2 = 0._r8
1702
1703
170414225181422518 do k = ktm,pver
170514225181422518 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1706 kp1 = min(pver,k+1)
170762473826247382 do i = il1g,il2g
1708 ii = ideep(i)
1709
1710! version 1 hard to check for roundoff errors
1711 dcondt(i,k) = &
1712 +(mu(i,kp1)* (conu(i,kp1)-chat(i,kp1)) &
1713 -mu(i,k)* (conu(i,k)-chat(i,k)) &
1714 +md(i,kp1)* (cond(i,kp1)-chat(i,kp1)) &
1715 -md(i,k)* (cond(i,k)-chat(i,k)) &
1716 )/dp(i,k)
1717
1718 end do
1719 end do
1720
1721 ! dcont for bottom layer
1722 !
1723 !DIR$ NOINTERCHANGE
1724129532236028 do k = kbm,pver
1725129532129532 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1726565306565306 do i = il1g,il2g
1727565306565306 if (k == mx(i)) then
1728
1729 ! version 1
1730449718449718 dcondt(i,k) = (1._r8/dp(i,k))* &
1731 (-mu(i,k)*(conu(i,k)-chat(i,k)) &
1732 -md(i,k)*(cond(i,k)-chat(i,k)) &
1733 )
1734 end if
1735 end do
1736 end do
1737
1738! Initialize to zero everywhere, then scatter tendency back to full array
17395111808060915712 dqdt(:,:,m) = 0._r8
1740
174131948803301376 do k = 1,pver
17421349154016686420 do i = il1g,il2g
1743 ii = ideep(i)
1744 dqdt(ii,k,m) = dcondt(i,k)
1745 ! Output apparent force on the mean flow from pressure gradient
1746 pguall(ii,k,m) = -pgu(i,k)
1747 pgdall(ii,k,m) = -pgd(i,k)
1748 icwu(ii,k,m) = conu(i,k)
1749 icwd(ii,k,m) = cond(i,k)
1750 end do
1751 end do
1752
1753 ! Calculate momentum flux in units of mb*m/s2
1754
175514225181529014 do k = ktm,pver
175662473827669900 do i = il1g,il2g
1757 ii = ideep(i)
1758 mflux(i,k,m) = &
1759 -mu(i,k)* (conu(i,k)-chat(i,k)) &
1760 -md(i,k)* (cond(i,k)-chat(i,k))
1761 end do
1762 end do
1763
1764
1765 ! Calculate winds at the end of the time step
1766
176714225181529014 do k = ktm,pver
176862473827669900 do i = il1g,il2g
1769 ii = ideep(i)
1770 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1771 kp1 = k+1
1772 windf(i,k,m) = const(i,k) - (mflux(i,kp1,m) - mflux(i,k,m)) * dt /dp(i,k)
1773
1774 end do
1775 end do
1776
1777 end if ! for domomtran
1778 end do
1779
1780 ! Need to add an energy fix to account for the dissipation of kinetic energy
1781 ! Formulation follows from Boville and Bretherton (2003)
1782 ! formulation by PJR
1783
1784711259764507 do k = ktm,pver
1785711259711259 km1 = max(1,k-1)
1786 kp1 = min(pver,k+1)
178731236913123691 do i = il1g,il2g
1788
1789 ii = ideep(i)
1790
1791 ! calculate the KE fluxes at top and bot of layer
1792 ! based on a discrete approximation to b&b eq(35) F_KE = u*F_u + v*F_v at interface
1793 utop = (wind0(i,k,1)+wind0(i,km1,1))/2._r8
1794 vtop = (wind0(i,k,2)+wind0(i,km1,2))/2._r8
1795 ubot = (wind0(i,kp1,1)+wind0(i,k,1))/2._r8
1796 vbot = (wind0(i,kp1,2)+wind0(i,k,2))/2._r8
1797 fket = utop*mflux(i,k,1) + vtop*mflux(i,k,2) ! top of layer
1798 fkeb = ubot*mflux(i,k+1,1) + vbot*mflux(i,k+1,2) ! bot of layer
1799
1800 ! divergence of these fluxes should give a conservative redistribution of KE
1801 ketend_cons = (fket-fkeb)/dp(i,k)
1802
1803 ! tendency in kinetic energy resulting from the momentum transport
1804 ketend = ((windf(i,k,1)**2 + windf(i,k,2)**2) - (wind0(i,k,1)**2 + wind0(i,k,2)**2))*0.5_r8/dt
1805
1806 ! the difference should be the dissipation
1807 gset2 = ketend_cons - ketend
1808 gseten(i,k) = gset2
1809
1810 end do
1811
1812 end do
1813
1814 ! Scatter dry static energy to full array
181515974401650688 do k = 1,pver
181667457708343210 do i = il1g,il2g
1817 ii = ideep(i)
1818 seten(ii,k) = gseten(i,k)
1819
1820 end do
1821 end do
1822
1823 return
1824end subroutine momtran
1825
1826!=========================================================================================
1827
1828subroutine buoyan(lchnk ,ncol , &
1829 q ,t ,p ,z ,pf , &
1830 tp ,qstp ,tl ,rl ,cape , &
1831 pblt ,lcl ,lel ,lon ,mx , &
1832 rd ,grav ,cp ,msg , &
1833 tpert )
1834!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1835!
1836! Purpose:
1837! <Say what the routine does>
1838!
1839! Method:
1840! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
1841! <Also include any applicable external references.>
1842!
1843! Author:
1844! This is contributed code not fully standardized by the CCM core group.
1845! The documentation has been enhanced to the degree that we are able.
1846! Reviewed: P. Rasch, April 1996
1847!
1848!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1849 implicit none
1850!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1851!
1852! input arguments
1853!
1854 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
1855 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
1856
1857 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver) ! spec. humidity
1858 real(r8), intent(in) :: t(pcols,pver) ! temperature
1859 real(r8), intent(in) :: p(pcols,pver) ! pressure
1860 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! height
1861 real(r8), intent(in) :: pf(pcols,pver+1) ! pressure at interfaces
1862 real(r8), intent(in) :: pblt(pcols) ! index of pbl depth
1863 real(r8), intent(in) :: tpert(pcols) ! perturbation temperature by pbl processes
1864
1865!
1866! output arguments
1867!
1868 real(r8), intent(out) :: tp(pcols,pver) ! parcel temperature
1869 real(r8), intent(out) :: qstp(pcols,pver) ! saturation mixing ratio of parcel
1870 real(r8), intent(out) :: tl(pcols) ! parcel temperature at lcl
1871 real(r8), intent(out) :: cape(pcols) ! convective aval. pot. energy.
1872 integer lcl(pcols) !
1873 integer lel(pcols) !
1874 integer lon(pcols) ! level of onset of deep convection
1875 integer mx(pcols) ! level of max moist static energy
1876!
1877!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
1878!
1879 real(r8) capeten(pcols,5) ! provisional value of cape
1880 real(r8) tv(pcols,pver) !
1881 real(r8) tpv(pcols,pver) !
1882 real(r8) buoy(pcols,pver)
1883
1884 real(r8) a1(pcols)
1885 real(r8) a2(pcols)
1886 real(r8) estp(pcols)
1887 real(r8) pl(pcols)
1888 real(r8) plexp(pcols)
1889 real(r8) hmax(pcols)
1890 real(r8) hmn(pcols)
1891 real(r8) y(pcols)
1892
1893 logical plge600(pcols)
1894 integer knt(pcols)
1895 integer lelten(pcols,5)
1896
1897 real(r8) cp
1898 real(r8) e
1899 real(r8) grav
1900
1901 integer i
1902 integer k
1903 integer msg
1904 integer n
1905
1906 real(r8) rd
1907 real(r8) rl
1908#ifdef PERGRO
1909 real(r8) rhd
1910#endif
1911!
1912!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1913!
1914 do n = 1,5
1915 do i = 1,ncol
1916 lelten(i,n) = pver
1917 capeten(i,n) = 0._r8
1918 end do
1919 end do
1920!
1921 do i = 1,ncol
1922 lon(i) = pver
1923 knt(i) = 0
1924 lel(i) = pver
1925 mx(i) = lon(i)
1926 cape(i) = 0._r8
1927 hmax(i) = 0._r8
1928 end do
1929
1930 tp(:ncol,:) = t(:ncol,:)
1931 qstp(:ncol,:) = q(:ncol,:)
1932
1933!!! RBN - Initialize tv and buoy for output.
1934!!! tv=tv : tpv=tpv : qstp=q : buoy=0.
1935 tv(:ncol,:) = t(:ncol,:) *(1._r8+1.608_r8*q(:ncol,:))/ (1._r8+q(:ncol,:))
1936 tpv(:ncol,:) = tv(:ncol,:)
1937 buoy(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
1938
1939!
1940! set "launching" level(mx) to be at maximum moist static energy.
1941! search for this level stops at planetary boundary layer top.
1942!
1943#ifdef PERGRO
1944 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
1945 do i = 1,ncol
1946 hmn(i) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*q(i,k)
1947!
1948! Reset max moist static energy level when relative difference exceeds 1.e-4
1949!
1950 rhd = (hmn(i) - hmax(i))/(hmn(i) + hmax(i))
1951 if (k >= nint(pblt(i)) .and. k <= lon(i) .and. rhd > -1.e-4_r8) then
1952 hmax(i) = hmn(i)
1953 mx(i) = k
1954 end if
1955 end do
1956 end do
1957#else
1958 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
1959 do i = 1,ncol
1960 hmn(i) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*q(i,k)
1961 if (k >= nint(pblt(i)) .and. k <= lon(i) .and. hmn(i) > hmax(i)) then
1962 hmax(i) = hmn(i)
1963 mx(i) = k
1964 end if
1965 end do
1966 end do
1967#endif
1968!
1969 do i = 1,ncol
1970 lcl(i) = mx(i)
1971 e = p(i,mx(i))*q(i,mx(i))/ (eps1+q(i,mx(i)))
1972 tl(i) = 2840._r8/ (3.5_r8*log(t(i,mx(i)))-log(e)-4.805_r8) + 55._r8
1973 if (tl(i) < t(i,mx(i))) then
1974 plexp(i) = (1._r8/ (0.2854_r8* (1._r8-0.28_r8*q(i,mx(i)))))
1975 pl(i) = p(i,mx(i))* (tl(i)/t(i,mx(i)))**plexp(i)
1976 else
1977 tl(i) = t(i,mx(i))
1978 pl(i) = p(i,mx(i))
1979 end if
1980 end do
1981
1982!
1983! calculate lifting condensation level (lcl).
1984!
1985 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
1986 do i = 1,ncol
1987 if (k <= mx(i) .and. (p(i,k) > pl(i) .and. p(i,k-1) <= pl(i))) then
1988 lcl(i) = k - 1
1989 end if
1990 end do
1991 end do
1992!
1993! if lcl is above the nominal level of non-divergence (600 mbs),
1994! no deep convection is permitted (ensuing calculations
1995! skipped and cape retains initialized value of zero).
1996!
1997 do i = 1,ncol
1998 plge600(i) = pl(i).ge.600._r8
1999 end do
2000!
2001! initialize parcel properties in sub-cloud layer below lcl.
2002!
2003 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
2004 do i=1,ncol
2005 if (k > lcl(i) .and. k <= mx(i) .and. plge600(i)) then
2006 tv(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1._r8+1.608_r8*q(i,k))/ (1._r8+q(i,k))
2007 qstp(i,k) = q(i,mx(i))
2008 tp(i,k) = t(i,mx(i))* (p(i,k)/p(i,mx(i)))**(0.2854_r8* (1._r8-0.28_r8*q(i,mx(i))))
2009!
2010! buoyancy is increased by 0.5 k as in tiedtke
2011!
2012!-jjh tpv (i,k)=tp(i,k)*(1.+1.608*q(i,mx(i)))/
2013!-jjh 1 (1.+q(i,mx(i)))
2014 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k)+tpert(i))*(1._r8+1.608_r8*q(i,mx(i)))/ (1._r8+q(i,mx(i)))
2015 buoy(i,k) = tpv(i,k) - tv(i,k) + tiedke_add
2016 end if
2017 end do
2018 end do
2019
2020!
2021! define parcel properties at lcl (i.e. level immediately above pl).
2022!
2023 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
2024 do i=1,ncol
2025 if (k == lcl(i) .and. plge600(i)) then
2026 tv(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1._r8+1.608_r8*q(i,k))/ (1._r8+q(i,k))
2027 qstp(i,k) = q(i,mx(i))
2028 tp(i,k) = tl(i)* (p(i,k)/pl(i))**(0.2854_r8* (1._r8-0.28_r8*qstp(i,k)))
2029! estp(i) =exp(21.656_r8 - 5418._r8/tp(i,k))
2030! use of different formulas for es has about 1 g/kg difference
2031! in qs at t= 300k, and 0.02 g/kg at t=263k, with the formula
2032! above giving larger qs.
2033 call qsat_hPa(tp(i,k), p(i,k), estp(i), qstp(i,k))
2034 a1(i) = cp / rl + qstp(i,k) * (1._r8+ qstp(i,k) / eps1) * rl * eps1 / &
2035 (rd * tp(i,k) ** 2)
2036 a2(i) = .5_r8* (qstp(i,k)* (1._r8+2._r8/eps1*qstp(i,k))* &
2037 (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*eps1**2*rl*rl/ &
2038 (rd**2*tp(i,k)**4)-qstp(i,k)* &
2039 (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*2._r8*eps1*rl/ &
2040 (rd*tp(i,k)**3))
2041 a1(i) = 1._r8/a1(i)
2042 a2(i) = -a2(i)*a1(i)**3
2043 y(i) = q(i,mx(i)) - qstp(i,k)
2044 tp(i,k) = tp(i,k) + a1(i)*y(i) + a2(i)*y(i)**2
2045 call qsat_hPa(tp(i,k), p(i,k), estp(i), qstp(i,k))
2046!
2047! buoyancy is increased by 0.5 k in cape calculation.
2048! dec. 9, 1994
2049!-jjh tpv(i,k) =tp(i,k)*(1.+1.608*qstp(i,k))/(1.+q(i,mx(i)))
2050!
2051 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k)+tpert(i))* (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)) / (1._r8+q(i,mx(i)))
2052 buoy(i,k) = tpv(i,k) - tv(i,k) + tiedke_add
2053 end if
2054 end do
2055 end do
2056!
2057! main buoyancy calculation.
2058!
2059 do k = pver - 1,msg + 1,-1
2060 do i=1,ncol
2061 if (k < lcl(i) .and. plge600(i)) then
2062 tv(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1._r8+1.608_r8*q(i,k))/ (1._r8+q(i,k))
2063 qstp(i,k) = qstp(i,k+1)
2064 tp(i,k) = tp(i,k+1)* (p(i,k)/p(i,k+1))**(0.2854_r8* (1._r8-0.28_r8*qstp(i,k)))
2065 call qsat_hPa(tp(i,k), p(i,k), estp(i), qstp(i,k))
2066 a1(i) = cp/rl + qstp(i,k)* (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*rl*eps1/ (rd*tp(i,k)**2)
2067 a2(i) = .5_r8* (qstp(i,k)* (1._r8+2._r8/eps1*qstp(i,k))* &
2068 (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*eps1**2*rl*rl/ &
2069 (rd**2*tp(i,k)**4)-qstp(i,k)* &
2070 (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*2._r8*eps1*rl/ &
2071 (rd*tp(i,k)**3))
2072 a1(i) = 1._r8/a1(i)
2073 a2(i) = -a2(i)*a1(i)**3
2074 y(i) = qstp(i,k+1) - qstp(i,k)
2075 tp(i,k) = tp(i,k) + a1(i)*y(i) + a2(i)*y(i)**2
2076 call qsat_hPa(tp(i,k), p(i,k), estp(i), qstp(i,k))
2077!-jjh tpv(i,k) =tp(i,k)*(1.+1.608*qstp(i,k))/
2078!jt (1.+q(i,mx(i)))
2079 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k)+tpert(i))* (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k))/(1._r8+q(i,mx(i)))
2080 buoy(i,k) = tpv(i,k) - tv(i,k) + tiedke_add
2081 end if
2082 end do
2083 end do
2084
2085!
2086 do k = msg + 2,pver
2087 do i = 1,ncol
2088 if (k < lcl(i) .and. plge600(i)) then
2089 if (buoy(i,k+1) > 0._r8 .and. buoy(i,k) <= 0._r8) then
2090 knt(i) = min(5,knt(i) + 1)
2091 lelten(i,knt(i)) = k
2092 end if
2093 end if
2094 end do
2095 end do
2096!
2097! calculate convective available potential energy (cape).
2098!
2099 do n = 1,5
2100 do k = msg + 1,pver
2101 do i = 1,ncol
2102 if (plge600(i) .and. k <= mx(i) .and. k > lelten(i,n)) then
2103 capeten(i,n) = capeten(i,n) + rd*buoy(i,k)*log(pf(i,k+1)/pf(i,k))
2104 end if
2105 end do
2106 end do
2107 end do
2108!
2109! find maximum cape from all possible tentative capes from
2110! one sounding,
2111! and use it as the final cape, april 26, 1995
2112!
2113 do n = 1,5
2114 do i = 1,ncol
2115 if (capeten(i,n) > cape(i)) then
2116 cape(i) = capeten(i,n)
2117 lel(i) = lelten(i,n)
2118 end if
2119 end do
2120 end do
2121!
2122! put lower bound on cape for diagnostic purposes.
2123!
2124 do i = 1,ncol
2125 cape(i) = max(cape(i), 0._r8)
2126 end do
2127!
2128 return
2129end subroutine buoyan
2130
21315269652696subroutine cldprp(lchnk , &
2132 q ,t ,u ,v ,p , &
2133 z ,s ,mu ,eu ,du , &
2134 md ,ed ,sd ,qd ,mc , &
2135 qu ,su ,zf ,qst ,hmn , &
2136 hsat ,shat ,ql , &
2137 cmeg ,jb ,lel ,jt ,jlcl , &
2138 mx ,j0 ,jd ,rl ,il2g , &
2139 rd ,grav ,cp ,msg , &
2140 pflx ,evp ,cu ,rprd ,limcnv , &
2141 tut ,tdt ,dz ,rppe ,eps0 , &
2142 qsthat ,hsthat ,wtmu ,wtdu , &
2143 wteu ,wted ,wtdn ,wtmd ,wtevp , &
2144 qds ,c0mask ,landfrac)
2145!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2146!
2147! Purpose:
2148! <Say what the routine does>
2149!
2150! Method:
2151! may 09/91 - guang jun zhang, m.lazare, n.mcfarlane.
2152! original version cldprop.
2153!
2154! Author: See above, modified by P. Rasch
2155! This is contributed code not fully standardized by the CCM core group.
2156!
2157! this code is very much rougher than virtually anything else in the CCM
2158! there are debug statements left strewn about and code segments disabled
2159! these are to facilitate future development. We expect to release a
2160! cleaner code in a future release
2161!
2162! the documentation has been enhanced to the degree that we are able
2163!
2164!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2165
2166 implicit none
2167
2168!------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2169!
2170! Input arguments
2171!
2172 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
2173
2174 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver) ! spec. humidity of env
2175 real(r8), intent(in) :: t(pcols,pver) ! temp of env
2176 real(r8), intent(in) :: p(pcols,pver) ! pressure of env
2177 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! height of env
2178 real(r8), intent(in) :: s(pcols,pver) ! normalized dry static energy of env
2179 real(r8), intent(in) :: zf(pcols,pverp) ! height of interfaces
2180 real(r8), intent(in) :: u(pcols,pver) ! zonal velocity of env
2181 real(r8), intent(in) :: v(pcols,pver) ! merid. velocity of env
2182
2183 real(r8), intent(in) :: landfrac(pcols) ! RBN Landfrac
2184
2185 integer, intent(in) :: jb(pcols) ! updraft base level
2186 integer, intent(in) :: lel(pcols) ! updraft launch level
2187 integer, intent(out) :: jt(pcols) ! updraft plume top
2188 integer, intent(out) :: jlcl(pcols) ! updraft lifting cond level
2189 integer, intent(in) :: mx(pcols) ! updraft base level (same is jb)
2190 integer, intent(out) :: j0(pcols) ! level where updraft begins detraining
2191 integer, intent(out) :: jd(pcols) ! level of downdraft
2192 integer, intent(in) :: limcnv ! convection limiting level
2193 integer, intent(in) :: il2g !CORE GROUP REMOVE
2194 integer, intent(in) :: msg ! missing moisture vals (always 0)
2195 real(r8), intent(in) :: rl ! latent heat of vap
2196 real(r8), intent(in) :: shat(pcols,pver) ! interface values of dry stat energy
2197!
2198! output
2199!
2200 real(r8), intent(out) :: rprd(pcols,pver) ! rate of production of precip at that layer
2201 real(r8), intent(out) :: du(pcols,pver) ! detrainement rate of updraft
2202 real(r8), intent(out) :: ed(pcols,pver) ! entrainment rate of downdraft
2203 real(r8), intent(out) :: eu(pcols,pver) ! entrainment rate of updraft
2204 real(r8), intent(out) :: hmn(pcols,pver) ! moist stat energy of env
2205 real(r8), intent(out) :: hsat(pcols,pver) ! sat moist stat energy of env
2206 real(r8), intent(out) :: mc(pcols,pver) ! net mass flux
2207 real(r8), intent(out) :: md(pcols,pver) ! downdraft mass flux
2208 real(r8), intent(out) :: mu(pcols,pver) ! updraft mass flux
2209 real(r8), intent(out) :: pflx(pcols,pverp) ! precipitation flux thru layer
2210 real(r8), intent(out) :: qd(pcols,pver) ! spec humidity of downdraft
2211 real(r8), intent(out) :: ql(pcols,pver) ! liq water of updraft
2212 real(r8), intent(out) :: qst(pcols,pver) ! saturation mixing ratio of env.
2213 real(r8), intent(out) :: qu(pcols,pver) ! spec hum of updraft
2214 real(r8), intent(out) :: sd(pcols,pver) ! normalized dry stat energy of downdraft
2215 real(r8), intent(out) :: su(pcols,pver) ! normalized dry stat energy of updraft
2216
2217 !Needed for Water Tracers:
2218 real(r8), intent(out) :: tut(pcols,pver) !updraft temperature (from su)
2219 real(r8), intent(out) :: tdt(pcols,pver) !downdarft temperature (from sd)
2220 real(r8), intent(out) :: dz(pcols,pver) !Layer thickness [m]
2221 real(r8), intent(out) :: rppe(pcols,pver) !Rain production pre-evaporation
2222 real(r8), intent(out) :: eps0(pcols)
2223 real(r8), intent(out) :: qsthat(pcols,pver) !qsat at interfaces
2224 real(r8), intent(out) :: hsthat(pcols,pver) !hsat at interfaces
2225 real(r8), intent(out) :: qds(pcols,pver) !saturation mixing ratio in downdraft
2226 real(r8), intent(out) :: wtmu(pcols,pver) !initial updraft mass flux value
2227 real(r8), intent(out) :: wtdu(pcols,pver) !detrainment in updraft beginning values
2228 real(r8), intent(out) :: wteu(pcols,pver) !entrainment in updraft beginning values
2229 real(r8), intent(out) :: wted(pcols,pver) !entrainment in dwndraft beginning values (not needed)
2230 real(r8), intent(out) :: wtmd(pcols,pver) !donwdraft mass flux beginning values
2231 real(r8), intent(out) :: wtevp(pcols,pver) !evaporation rate pre-precip limited
2232 logical , intent(out) :: wtdn(pcols,pver) !Endpoint of updraft loop
2233
2234 real(r8) rd ! gas constant for dry air
2235 real(r8) grav ! gravity
2236 real(r8) cp ! heat capacity of dry air
2237
2238!
2239! Local workspace
2240!
2241 real(r8) gamma(pcols,pver)
2242! real(r8) dz(pcols,pver)
2243 real(r8) iprm(pcols,pver)
2244 real(r8) hu(pcols,pver)
2245 real(r8) hd(pcols,pver)
2246 real(r8) eps(pcols,pver)
2247 real(r8) f(pcols,pver)
2248 real(r8) k1(pcols,pver)
2249 real(r8) i2(pcols,pver)
2250 real(r8) ihat(pcols,pver)
2251 real(r8) i3(pcols,pver)
2252 real(r8) idag(pcols,pver)
2253 real(r8) i4(pcols,pver)
2254 ! real(r8) qsthat(pcols,pver)
2255 ! real(r8) hsthat(pcols,pver)
2256 real(r8) gamhat(pcols,pver)
2257 real(r8) cu(pcols,pver)
2258 real(r8) evp(pcols,pver)
2259 real(r8) cmeg(pcols,pver)
2260 ! real(r8) qds(pcols,pver)
2261! RBN For c0mask
2262 ! real(r8) c0mask(pcols)
2263 real(r8), intent(out) :: c0mask(pcols)
2264
2265 real(r8) hmin(pcols)
2266 real(r8) expdif(pcols)
2267 real(r8) expnum(pcols)
2268 real(r8) ftemp(pcols)
2269! real(r8) eps0(pcols)
2270 real(r8) rmue(pcols)
2271 real(r8) zuef(pcols)
2272 real(r8) zdef(pcols)
2273 real(r8) epsm(pcols)
2274 real(r8) ratmjb(pcols)
2275 real(r8) est(pcols)
2276 real(r8) totpcp(pcols)
2277 real(r8) totevp(pcols)
2278 real(r8) alfa(pcols)
2279 real(r8) ql1
2280 real(r8) tu
2281 real(r8) estu
2282 real(r8) qstu
2283
2284 real(r8) small
2285 real(r8) mdt
2286
2287 integer khighest
2288 integer klowest
2289 integer kount
2290 integer i,k
2291
2292 logical doit(pcols)
2293 logical done(pcols)
2294!
2295!------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2296!
2297224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2298 ftemp(i) = 0._r8
2299 expnum(i) = 0._r8
2300 expdif(i) = 0._r8
2301 c0mask(i) = c0_ocn * (1._r8-landfrac(i)) + c0_lnd * landfrac(i)
2302 end do
2303!
2304!jr Change from msg+1 to 1 to prevent blowup
2305!
230615808801633576 do k = 1,pver
230767457708326650 do i = 1,il2g
2308 dz(i,k) = zf(i,k) - zf(i,k+1)
2309 end do
2310 end do
2311
2312!
2313! initialize many output and work variables to zero
2314!
2315224859330251 pflx(:il2g,1) = 0
2316
231715808801633576 do k = 1,pver
231867457708326650 do i = 1,il2g
231967457706745770 k1(i,k) = 0._r8
2320 i2(i,k) = 0._r8
2321 i3(i,k) = 0._r8
2322 i4(i,k) = 0._r8
2323 mu(i,k) = 0._r8
2324 f(i,k) = 0._r8
2325 eps(i,k) = 0._r8
2326 eu(i,k) = 0._r8
2327 du(i,k) = 0._r8
2328 ql(i,k) = 0._r8
2329 cu(i,k) = 0._r8
2330 evp(i,k) = 0._r8
2331 wtevp(i,k) = 0._r8 !water tracers
2332 cmeg(i,k) = 0._r8
2333 qds(i,k) = q(i,k)
2334 md(i,k) = 0._r8
2335 ed(i,k) = 0._r8
2336 sd(i,k) = s(i,k)
2337 qd(i,k) = q(i,k)
2338 mc(i,k) = 0._r8
2339 qu(i,k) = q(i,k)
2340 su(i,k) = s(i,k)
234167457706745770 call qsat_hPa(t(i,k), p(i,k), est(i), qst(i,k))
234267457706745770 tdt(i,k) = sd(i,k) - grav/cp*zf(i,k) !water tracers
2343 tut(i,k) = su(i,k) - grav/cp*zf(i,k)
2344!++bee
2345 if ( p(i,k)-est(i) <= 0._r8 ) then
234600 qst(i,k) = 1.0_r8
2347 end if
2348!--bee
2349 gamma(i,k) = qst(i,k)*(1._r8 + qst(i,k)/eps1)*eps1*rl/(rd*t(i,k)**2)*rl/cp
2350 hmn(i,k) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*q(i,k)
2351 hsat(i,k) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*qst(i,k)
2352 hu(i,k) = hmn(i,k)
2353 hd(i,k) = hmn(i,k)
2354 rprd(i,k) = 0._r8
2355 end do
2356 end do
2357!
2358!jr Set to zero things which make this routine blow up
2359!
2360210784263480 do k=1,msg
23618994361110220 do i=1,il2g
2362 rprd(i,k) = 0._r8
2363 end do
2364 end do
2365!
2366! interpolate the layer values of qst, hsat and gamma to
2367! layer interfaces
2368!
2369263480316176 do k = 1, msg+1
237011242951387775 do i = 1,il2g
2371 hsthat(i,k) = hsat(i,k)
2372 qsthat(i,k) = qst(i,k)
2373 gamhat(i,k) = gamma(i,k)
2374 end do
2375 end do
2376224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2377 totpcp(i) = 0._r8
2378 totevp(i) = 0._r8
2379 end do
238013174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
238156214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
238256214755621475 if (abs(qst(i,k-1)-qst(i,k)) > 1.E-6_r8) then
2383551180311023606 qsthat(i,k) = log(qst(i,k-1)/qst(i,k))*qst(i,k-1)*qst(i,k)/ (qst(i,k-1)-qst(i,k))
2384 else
2385109672109672 qsthat(i,k) = qst(i,k)
2386 end if
238756214755621475 hsthat(i,k) = cp*shat(i,k) + rl*qsthat(i,k)
2388 if (abs(gamma(i,k-1)-gamma(i,k)) > 1.E-6_r8) then
2389562112511242250 gamhat(i,k) = log(gamma(i,k-1)/gamma(i,k))*gamma(i,k-1)*gamma(i,k)/ &
2390 (gamma(i,k-1)-gamma(i,k))
2391 else
2392350350 gamhat(i,k) = gamma(i,k)
2393 end if
2394 end do
2395 end do
2396!
2397! initialize cloud top to highest plume top.
2398!jr changed hard-wired 4 to limcnv+1 (not to exceed pver)
2399!
2400843136948528 jt(:) = pver
2401224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2402 jt(i) = max(lel(i),limcnv+1)
2403 jt(i) = min(jt(i),pver)
2404 jd(i) = pver
2405 jlcl(i) = lel(i)
2406 hmin(i) = 1.E6_r8
2407 end do
2408
2409!
2410! find the level of minimum hsat, where detrainment starts
2411!
2412
241313700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
241458463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2415584633410280395 if (hsat(i,k) <= hmin(i) .and. k >= jt(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) then
2416663113663113 hmin(i) = hsat(i,k)
2417 j0(i) = k
2418 end if
2419 end do
2420 end do
2421224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2422 j0(i) = min(j0(i),jb(i)-2)
2423 j0(i) = max(j0(i),jt(i)+2)
2424!
2425! Fix from Guang Zhang to address out of bounds array reference
2426!
2427 j0(i) = min(j0(i),pver)
2428 end do
2429!
2430! Initialize certain arrays inside cloud
2431!
243213700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
243358463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
243458463348588033 if (k >= jt(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) then
243527294762729476 hu(i,k) = hmn(i,mx(i)) + cp*tiedke_add
2436 su(i,k) = s(i,mx(i)) + tiedke_add
2437 end if
2438 end do
2439 end do
2440!
2441! *********************************************************
2442! compute taylor series for approximate eps(z) below
2443! *********************************************************
2444!
244513174001370096 do k = pver - 1,msg + 1,-1
244656214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
2447562147511230727 if (k < jb(i) .and. k >= jt(i)) then
244825046172504617 k1(i,k) = k1(i,k+1) + (hmn(i,mx(i))-hmn(i,k))*dz(i,k)
2449 ihat(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (k1(i,k+1)+k1(i,k))
2450 i2(i,k) = i2(i,k+1) + ihat(i,k)*dz(i,k)
2451 idag(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (i2(i,k+1)+i2(i,k))
2452 i3(i,k) = i3(i,k+1) + idag(i,k)*dz(i,k)
2453 iprm(i,k) = 0.5_r8* (i3(i,k+1)+i3(i,k))
2454 i4(i,k) = i4(i,k+1) + iprm(i,k)*dz(i,k)
2455 end if
2456 end do
2457 end do
2458!
2459! re-initialize hmin array for ensuing calculation.
2460!
2461224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2462 hmin(i) = 1.E6_r8
2463 end do
246413700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
246558463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2466584633410033567 if (k >= j0(i) .and. k <= jb(i) .and. hmn(i,k) <= hmin(i)) then
2467299631299631 hmin(i) = hmn(i,k)
2468 expdif(i) = hmn(i,mx(i)) - hmin(i)
2469 end if
2470 end do
2471 end do
2472!
2473! *********************************************************
2474! compute approximate eps(z) using above taylor series
2475! *********************************************************
2476!
247713174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
247856214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
247956214755621475 expnum(i) = 0._r8
2480 ftemp(i) = 0._r8
248127416992741699 if (k < jt(i) .or. k >= jb(i)) then
248231168583116858 k1(i,k) = 0._r8
2483 expnum(i) = 0._r8
2484 else
248525046172504617 expnum(i) = hmn(i,mx(i)) - (hsat(i,k-1)*(zf(i,k)-z(i,k)) + &
2486 hsat(i,k)* (z(i,k-1)-zf(i,k)))/(z(i,k-1)-z(i,k))
2487 end if
2488562147513012528 if ((expdif(i) > 100._r8 .and. expnum(i) > 0._r8) .and. &
2489 k1(i,k) > expnum(i)*dz(i,k)) then
249017574301757430 ftemp(i) = expnum(i)/k1(i,k)
249117574301757430 f(i,k) = ftemp(i) + i2(i,k)/k1(i,k)*ftemp(i)**2 + &
249217574301757430 (2._r8*i2(i,k)**2-k1(i,k)*i3(i,k))/k1(i,k)**2* &
249317574303514860 ftemp(i)**3 + (-5._r8*k1(i,k)*i2(i,k)*i3(i,k)+ &
2494 5._r8*i2(i,k)**3+k1(i,k)**2*i4(i,k))/ &
2495 k1(i,k)**3*ftemp(i)**4
2496 f(i,k) = max(f(i,k),0._r8)
2497 f(i,k) = min(f(i,k),0.0002_r8)
2498 end if
2499 end do
2500 end do
2501224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2502224859224859 if (j0(i) < jb(i)) then
2503224859229433 if (f(i,j0(i)) < 1.E-6_r8 .and. f(i,j0(i)+1) > f(i,j0(i))) j0(i) = j0(i) + 1
2504 end if
2505 end do
250613174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
250756214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
250856214758363174 if (k >= jt(i) .and. k <= j0(i)) then
2509866965866965 f(i,k) = max(f(i,k),f(i,k-1))
2510 end if
2511 end do
2512 end do
2513224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2514 eps0(i) = f(i,j0(i))
2515 eps(i,jb(i)) = eps0(i)
2516 end do
2517!
2518! This is set to match the Rasch and Kristjansson paper
2519!
252013700961422792 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
252158463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
252258463347945927 if (k >= j0(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) then
252320873702087370 eps(i,k) = f(i,j0(i))
2524 end if
2525 end do
2526 end do
252713700961422792 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
252858463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2529584633410235181 if (k < j0(i) .and. k >= jt(i)) eps(i,k) = f(i,k)
2530 end do
2531 end do
2532!
2533! specify the updraft mass flux mu, entrainment eu, detrainment du
2534! and moist static energy hu.
2535! here and below mu, eu,du, md and ed are all normalized by mb
2536!
2537224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2538224859224859 if (eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2539222498222498 mu(i,jb(i)) = 1._r8
2540 eu(i,jb(i)) = mu(i,jb(i))/dz(i,jb(i))
2541 end if
2542 end do
254313700961422792 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
254458463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2545584633414338097 if (eps0(i) > 0._r8 .and. (k >= jt(i) .and. k < jb(i))) then
254624735462473546 zuef(i) = zf(i,k) - zf(i,jb(i))
254724735462473546 rmue(i) = (1._r8/eps0(i))* (exp(eps(i,k+1)*zuef(i))-1._r8)/zuef(i)
254824735462473546 mu(i,k) = (1._r8/eps0(i))* (exp(eps(i,k )*zuef(i))-1._r8)/zuef(i)
2549 eu(i,k) = (rmue(i)-mu(i,k+1))/dz(i,k)
2550 du(i,k) = (rmue(i)-mu(i,k))/dz(i,k)
2551 end if
2552 end do
2553 end do
2554!
25555269652696 khighest = pverp
2556 klowest = 1
2557224859224859 do i=1,il2g
2558 khighest = min(khighest,lel(i))
2559 klowest = max(klowest,jb(i))
2560 end do
2561702042754738 do k = klowest-1,khighest,-1
256230625313764573 do i = 1,il2g
256330625318617547 if (k <= jb(i)-1 .and. k >= lel(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
256424735462473546 if (mu(i,k) < 0.02_r8) then
2565133401133401 hu(i,k) = hmn(i,k)
2566 mu(i,k) = 0._r8
2567 eu(i,k) = 0._r8
2568 du(i,k) = mu(i,k+1)/dz(i,k)
2569 else
257023401452340145 hu(i,k) = mu(i,k+1)/mu(i,k)*hu(i,k+1) + &
2571 dz(i,k)/mu(i,k)* (eu(i,k)*hmn(i,k)- du(i,k)*hsat(i,k))
2572 end if
2573 end if
2574 end do
2575 end do
2576
2577!
2578! reset cloud top index beginning from two layers above the
2579! cloud base (i.e. if cloud is only one layer thick, top is not reset
2580!
2581224859277555 do i=1,il2g
2582 doit(i) = .true.
2583 end do
2584702042754738 do k=klowest-2,khighest-1,-1
258530625313764573 do i=1,il2g
258630625317397449 if (doit(i) .and. k <= jb(i)-2 .and. k >= lel(i)-1) then
258721613932745748 if (hu(i,k) <= hsthat(i,k) .and. hu(i,k+1) > hsthat(i,k+1) &
2588 .and. mu(i,k) >= 0.02_r8) then
258965846584 if (hu(i,k)-hsthat(i,k) < -2000._r8) then
259019231923 jt(i) = k + 1
2591 doit(i) = .false.
2592 else
259346614661 jt(i) = k
2594 doit(i) = .false.
2595 end if
259621548094268123 else if (hu(i,k) > hu(i,jb(i)) .or. mu(i,k) < 0.02_r8) then
2597218275218275 jt(i) = k + 1
2598 doit(i) = .false.
2599 end if
2600 end if
2601 end do
2602 end do
260313700961422792 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
260458463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
260558463349151455 if (k >= lel(i) .and. k <= jt(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2606532351532351 mu(i,k) = 0._r8
2607 eu(i,k) = 0._r8
2608 du(i,k) = 0._r8
2609 hu(i,k) = hmn(i,k)
2610 end if
261158463346071193 if (k == jt(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2612222498222498 du(i,k) = mu(i,k+1)/dz(i,k)
2613 eu(i,k) = 0._r8
2614 mu(i,k) = 0._r8
2615 end if
2616 end do
2617 end do
2618!
2619! specify downdraft properties (no downdrafts if jd.ge.jb).
2620! scale down downward mass flux profile so that net flux
2621! (up-down) at cloud base in not negative.
2622!
2623224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2624!
2625! in normal downdraft strength run alfa=0.2. In test4 alfa=0.1
2626!
2627224859224859 alfa(i) = 0.1_r8
2628 jt(i) = min(jt(i),jb(i)-1)
2629 jd(i) = max(j0(i),jt(i)+1)
2630 jd(i) = min(jd(i),jb(i))
2631 hd(i,jd(i)) = hmn(i,jd(i)-1)
2632211806211806 if (jd(i) < jb(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2633211806211806 epsm(i) = eps0(i)
2634 md(i,jd(i)) = -alfa(i)*epsm(i)/eps0(i)
2635 end if
2636 end do
263713700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
263858463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
263958463349237895 if ((k > jd(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
264016896691689669 zdef(i) = zf(i,jd(i)) - zf(i,k)
264116896691689669 md(i,k) = -alfa(i)/ (2._r8*eps0(i))*(exp(2._r8*epsm(i)*zdef(i))-1._r8)/zdef(i)
2642 end if
2643 end do
2644 end do
264513700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
264658463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2647584633413026574 if ((k >= jt(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8 .and. jd(i) < jb(i)) then
264823648072364807 ratmjb(i) = min(abs(mu(i,jb(i))/md(i,jb(i))),1._r8)
2649 md(i,k) = md(i,k)*ratmjb(i)
2650 end if
2651 end do
2652 end do
2653
26545269652696 small = 1.e-20_r8
265513700961370096 do k = msg + 1,pver
265658463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2657584633410652606 if ((k >= jt(i) .and. k <= pver) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
265823969622396962 ed(i,k-1) = (md(i,k-1)-md(i,k))/dz(i,k-1)
2659 mdt = min(md(i,k),-small)
2660 hd(i,k) = (md(i,k-1)*hd(i,k-1) - dz(i,k-1)*ed(i,k-1)*hmn(i,k-1))/mdt
2661 end if
2662 end do
2663 end do
2664
2665!Needed for water tracers (NOTE: may be able to move this out of cldprp - JN)
26662529408030142112wted(:,:) = ed(:,:)
26672529408030142112wtmd(:,:) = md(:,:)
26682529408030142112wtmu(:,:) = mu(:,:)
26692529408030142112wtdu(:,:) = du(:,:)
26702529408030142112wteu(:,:) = eu(:,:)
2671
2672!
2673! calculate updraft and downdraft properties.
2674!
267513174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
267656214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
2677562147511374921 if ((k >= jd(i) .and. k <= jb(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8 .and. jd(i) < jb(i)) then
267819014751901475 qds(i,k) = qsthat(i,k) + gamhat(i,k)*(hd(i,k)-hsthat(i,k))/ &
2679 (rl*(1._r8 + gamhat(i,k)))
2680 end if
2681 end do
2682 end do
2683!
2684224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2685224859224859 done(i) = .false.
2686 !Water tracers: (Probably not needed)
268767457706970629 wtdn(i,:) = .false.
2688 end do
26895269652696 kount = 0
2690497083497083 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
269123998252936473 do i = 1,il2g
269223998252624684 if (k == jb(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2693222498222498 qu(i,k) = q(i,mx(i))
2694 su(i,k) = (hu(i,k)-rl*qu(i,k))/cp
2695 end if
269623998255045643 if (( .not. done(i) .and. k > jt(i) .and. k < jb(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
2697613507613507 su(i,k) = mu(i,k+1)/mu(i,k)*su(i,k+1) + &
2698 dz(i,k)/mu(i,k)* (eu(i,k)-du(i,k))*s(i,k)
2699 qu(i,k) = mu(i,k+1)/mu(i,k)*qu(i,k+1) + dz(i,k)/mu(i,k)* (eu(i,k)*q(i,k)- &
2700 du(i,k)*qst(i,k))
2701 tu = su(i,k) - grav/cp*zf(i,k)
2702613507613507 call qsat_hPa(tu, (p(i,k)+p(i,k-1))/2._r8, estu, qstu)
2703613507613507 tut(i,k) = tu !Needed for water tracer
2704 if (qu(i,k) >= qstu) then
2705210667210667 jlcl(i) = k
2706 kount = kount + 1
2707 done(i) = .true.
2708 wtdn(i,k) = .true.
2709 end if
2710 end if
2711 end do
2712536648536648 if (kount >= il2g) goto 690
2713 end do
2714690 continue
271513174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
271656214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
271756214759338107 if ((k > jt(i) .and. k <= jlcl(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
271815383551538355 su(i,k) = shat(i,k) + (hu(i,k)-hsthat(i,k))/(cp* (1._r8+gamhat(i,k)))
