2719 tut(i,k) = su(i,k) - grav/cp*zf(i,k)
2720 qu(i,k) = qsthat(i,k) + gamhat(i,k)*(hu(i,k)-hsthat(i,k))/ &
2721 (rl* (1._r8+gamhat(i,k)))
2722 end if
2723 end do
2724 end do
2725
2726! compute condensation in updraft
272713174001370096 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
272856214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
2729562147510190665 if (k >= jt(i) .and. k < jb(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
273021636932163693 cu(i,k) = ((mu(i,k)*su(i,k)-mu(i,k+1)*su(i,k+1))/ &
2731 dz(i,k)- (eu(i,k)-du(i,k))*s(i,k))/(rl/cp)
2732222498222498 if (k == jt(i)) cu(i,k) = 0._r8
273321636932163693 cu(i,k) = max(0._r8,cu(i,k))
2734 end if
2735 end do
2736 end do
2737
2738! compute condensed liquid, rain production rate
2739! accumulate total precipitation (condensation - detrainment of liquid)
2740! Note ql1 = ql(k) + rprd(k)*dz(k)/mu(k)
2741! The differencing is somewhat strange (e.g. du(i,k)*ql(i,k+1)) but is
2742! consistently applied.
2743! mu, ql are interface quantities
2744! cu, du, eu, rprd are midpoint quantites
274513174001370096 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
274656214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
274756214755621475 rprd(i,k) = 0._r8
274824031366732883 if (k >= jt(i) .and. k < jb(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8 .and. mu(i,k) >= 0.0_r8) then
274921636932163693 if (mu(i,k) > 0._r8) then
275019411951941195 ql1 = 1._r8/mu(i,k)* (mu(i,k+1)*ql(i,k+1)- &
2751 dz(i,k)*du(i,k)*ql(i,k+1)+dz(i,k)*cu(i,k))
2752 ql(i,k) = ql1/ (1._r8+dz(i,k)*c0mask(i))
2753 else
2754222498222498 ql(i,k) = 0._r8
2755 end if
275621636932163693 totpcp(i) = totpcp(i) + dz(i,k)*(cu(i,k)-du(i,k)*ql(i,k+1))
2757 rprd(i,k) = c0mask(i)*mu(i,k)*ql(i,k)
2758 end if
2759 end do
2760 end do
2761
2762!
2763!Needed for water tracers:
27642529408030142112rppe(:,:) = rprd(:,:)
2765!
2766224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2767 qd(i,jd(i)) = qds(i,jd(i))
2768 sd(i,jd(i)) = (hd(i,jd(i)) - rl*qd(i,jd(i)))/cp
2769 tdt(i,jd(i)) = sd(i,jd(i)) - grav/cp*zf(i,jd(i))
2770 end do
2771!
277213174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
277356214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
277456214759237895 if (k >= jd(i) .and. k < jb(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
277516896691689669 qd(i,k+1) = qds(i,k+1)
2776 evp(i,k) = -ed(i,k)*q(i,k) + (md(i,k)*qd(i,k)-md(i,k+1)*qd(i,k+1))/dz(i,k)
2777 evp(i,k) = max(evp(i,k),0._r8)
2778 mdt = min(md(i,k+1),-small)
2779 sd(i,k+1) = ((rl/cp*evp(i,k)-ed(i,k)*s(i,k))*dz(i,k) + md(i,k)*sd(i,k))/mdt
2780 tdt(i,k+1) = sd(i,k+1) - grav/cp*zf(i,k+1)
2781 totevp(i) = totevp(i) - dz(i,k)*ed(i,k)*q(i,k)
2782 end if
2783 end do
2784 end do
2785
2786 !Needed for water tracers:
27872529408030142112 wtevp(:,:) = evp(:,:)
2788
2789224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2790!*guang totevp(i) = totevp(i) + md(i,jd(i))*q(i,jd(i)-1) -
2791 totevp(i) = totevp(i) + md(i,jd(i))*qd(i,jd(i)) - md(i,jb(i))*qd(i,jb(i))
2792 end do
2793!!$ if (.true.) then
27945269652696 if (.false.) then
279500 do i = 1,il2g
279600 k = jb(i)
2797 if (eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
279800 evp(i,k) = -ed(i,k)*q(i,k) + (md(i,k)*qd(i,k))/dz(i,k)
2799 evp(i,k) = max(evp(i,k),0._r8)
2800 totevp(i) = totevp(i) - dz(i,k)*ed(i,k)*q(i,k)
2801 end if
2802 end do
2803 endif
2804
2805224859277555 do i = 1,il2g
2806 totpcp(i) = max(totpcp(i),0._r8)
2807 totevp(i) = max(totevp(i),0._r8)
2808 end do
2809!
281013174001370096 do k = msg + 2,pver
281156214756938875 do i = 1,il2g
2812562147510916625 if (totevp(i) > 0._r8 .and. totpcp(i) > 0._r8) then
281352915505291550 md(i,k) = md (i,k)*min(1._r8, totpcp(i)/(totevp(i)+totpcp(i)))
2814 ed(i,k) = ed (i,k)*min(1._r8, totpcp(i)/(totevp(i)+totpcp(i)))
2815 evp(i,k) = evp(i,k)*min(1._r8, totpcp(i)/(totevp(i)+totpcp(i)))
2816 else
2817329925329925 md(i,k) = 0._r8
2818 ed(i,k) = 0._r8
2819 evp(i,k) = 0._r8
2820 end if
2821! cmeg is the cloud water condensed - rain water evaporated
2822! rprd is the cloud water converted to rain - (rain evaporated)
2823 cmeg(i,k) = cu(i,k) - evp(i,k)
2824 rprd(i,k) = rprd(i,k)-evp(i,k)
2825 end do
2826 end do
2827
2828! compute the net precipitation flux across interfaces
2829224859330251 pflx(:il2g,1) = 0._r8
283015808801633576 do k = 2,pverp
283167457708326650 do i = 1,il2g
2832 pflx(i,k) = pflx(i,k-1) + rprd(i,k-1)*dz(i,k-1)
2833 end do
2834 end do
2835!
283613700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
283758463347216430 do i = 1,il2g
2838 mc(i,k) = mu(i,k) + md(i,k)
2839 end do
2840 end do
2841!
2842 return
28435269652696end subroutine cldprp
2844
28455269652696subroutine closure(lchnk , &
2846 q ,t ,p ,z ,s , &
2847 tp ,qs ,qu ,su ,mc , &
2848 du ,mu ,md ,qd ,sd , &
2849 qhat ,shat ,dp ,qstp ,zf , &
2850 ql ,dsubcld ,mb ,cape ,tl , &
2851 lcl ,lel ,jt ,mx ,il1g , &
2852 il2g ,rd ,grav ,cp ,rl , &
2853 msg ,capelmt )
2854!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2855!
2856! Purpose:
2857! <Say what the routine does>
2858!
2859! Method:
2860! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
2861! <Also include any applicable external references.>
2862!
2863! Author: G. Zhang and collaborators. CCM contact:P. Rasch
2864! This is contributed code not fully standardized by the CCM core group.
2865!
2866! this code is very much rougher than virtually anything else in the CCM
2867! We expect to release cleaner code in a future release
2868!
2869! the documentation has been enhanced to the degree that we are able
2870!
2871!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2872 use dycore, only: dycore_is, get_resolution
2873
2874 implicit none
2875
2876!
2877!-----------------------------Arguments---------------------------------
2878!
2879 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
2880
2881 real(r8), intent(inout) :: q(pcols,pver) ! spec humidity
2882 real(r8), intent(inout) :: t(pcols,pver) ! temperature
2883 real(r8), intent(inout) :: p(pcols,pver) ! pressure (mb)
2884 real(r8), intent(inout) :: mb(pcols) ! cloud base mass flux
2885 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! height (m)
2886 real(r8), intent(in) :: s(pcols,pver) ! normalized dry static energy
2887 real(r8), intent(in) :: tp(pcols,pver) ! parcel temp
2888 real(r8), intent(in) :: qs(pcols,pver) ! sat spec humidity
2889 real(r8), intent(in) :: qu(pcols,pver) ! updraft spec. humidity
2890 real(r8), intent(in) :: su(pcols,pver) ! normalized dry stat energy of updraft
2891 real(r8), intent(in) :: mc(pcols,pver) ! net convective mass flux
2892 real(r8), intent(in) :: du(pcols,pver) ! detrainment from updraft
2893 real(r8), intent(in) :: mu(pcols,pver) ! mass flux of updraft
2894 real(r8), intent(in) :: md(pcols,pver) ! mass flux of downdraft
2895 real(r8), intent(in) :: qd(pcols,pver) ! spec. humidity of downdraft
2896 real(r8), intent(in) :: sd(pcols,pver) ! dry static energy of downdraft
2897 real(r8), intent(in) :: qhat(pcols,pver) ! environment spec humidity at interfaces
2898 real(r8), intent(in) :: shat(pcols,pver) ! env. normalized dry static energy at intrfcs
2899 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(pcols,pver) ! pressure thickness of layers
2900 real(r8), intent(in) :: qstp(pcols,pver) ! spec humidity of parcel
2901 real(r8), intent(in) :: zf(pcols,pver+1) ! height of interface levels
2902 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(pcols,pver) ! liquid water mixing ratio
2903
2904 real(r8), intent(in) :: cape(pcols) ! available pot. energy of column
2905 real(r8), intent(in) :: tl(pcols)
2906 real(r8), intent(in) :: dsubcld(pcols) ! thickness of subcloud layer
2907
2908 integer, intent(in) :: lcl(pcols) ! index of lcl
2909 integer, intent(in) :: lel(pcols) ! index of launch leve
2910 integer, intent(in) :: jt(pcols) ! top of updraft
2911 integer, intent(in) :: mx(pcols) ! base of updraft
2912!
2913!--------------------------Local variables------------------------------
2914!
2915 real(r8) dtpdt(pcols,pver)
2916 real(r8) dqsdtp(pcols,pver)
2917 real(r8) dtmdt(pcols,pver)
2918 real(r8) dqmdt(pcols,pver)
2919 real(r8) dboydt(pcols,pver)
2920 real(r8) thetavp(pcols,pver)
2921 real(r8) thetavm(pcols,pver)
2922
2923 real(r8) dtbdt(pcols),dqbdt(pcols),dtldt(pcols)
2924 real(r8) beta
2925 real(r8) capelmt
2926 real(r8) cp
2927 real(r8) dadt(pcols)
2928 real(r8) debdt
2929 real(r8) dltaa
2930 real(r8) eb
2931 real(r8) grav
2932
2933 integer i
2934 integer il1g
2935 integer il2g
2936 integer k, kmin, kmax
2937 integer msg
2938
2939 real(r8) rd
2940 real(r8) rl
2941! change of subcloud layer properties due to convection is
2942! related to cumulus updrafts and downdrafts.
2943! mc(z)=f(z)*mb, mub=betau*mb, mdb=betad*mb are used
2944! to define betau, betad and f(z).
2945! note that this implies all time derivatives are in effect
2946! time derivatives per unit cloud-base mass flux, i.e. they
2947! have units of 1/mb instead of 1/sec.
2948!
2949224859277555 do i = il1g,il2g
2950224859224859 mb(i) = 0._r8
2951 eb = p(i,mx(i))*q(i,mx(i))/ (eps1+q(i,mx(i)))
2952 dtbdt(i) = (1._r8/dsubcld(i))* (mu(i,mx(i))*(shat(i,mx(i))-su(i,mx(i)))+ &
2953 md(i,mx(i))* (shat(i,mx(i))-sd(i,mx(i))))
2954 dqbdt(i) = (1._r8/dsubcld(i))* (mu(i,mx(i))*(qhat(i,mx(i))-qu(i,mx(i)))+ &
2955 md(i,mx(i))* (qhat(i,mx(i))-qd(i,mx(i))))
2956 debdt = eps1*p(i,mx(i))/ (eps1+q(i,mx(i)))**2*dqbdt(i)
2957 dtldt(i) = -2840._r8* (3.5_r8/t(i,mx(i))*dtbdt(i)-debdt/eb)/ &
2958224859449718 (3.5_r8*log(t(i,mx(i)))-log(eb)-4.805_r8)**2
2959 end do
2960!
2961! dtmdt and dqmdt are cumulus heating and drying.
2962!
296313700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
296458463347216430 do i = il1g,il2g
2965 dtmdt(i,k) = 0._r8
2966 dqmdt(i,k) = 0._r8
2967 end do
2968 end do
2969!
297013174001370096 do k = msg + 1,pver - 1
297156214756938875 do i = il1g,il2g
297256214755621475 if (k == jt(i)) then
2973224859224859 dtmdt(i,k) = (1._r8/dp(i,k))*(mu(i,k+1)* (su(i,k+1)-shat(i,k+1)- &
2974 rl/cp*ql(i,k+1))+md(i,k+1)* (sd(i,k+1)-shat(i,k+1)))
2975 dqmdt(i,k) = (1._r8/dp(i,k))*(mu(i,k+1)* (qu(i,k+1)- &
2976 qhat(i,k+1)+ql(i,k+1))+md(i,k+1)*(qd(i,k+1)-qhat(i,k+1)))
2977 end if
2978 end do
2979 end do
2980!
29815269652696 beta = 0._r8
298213174001317400 do k = msg + 1,pver - 1
298356214756938875 do i = il1g,il2g
298456214757574893 if (k > jt(i) .and. k < mx(i)) then
298519411951941195 dtmdt(i,k) = (mc(i,k)* (shat(i,k)-s(i,k))+mc(i,k+1)* (s(i,k)-shat(i,k+1)))/ &
2986 dp(i,k) - rl/cp*du(i,k)*(beta*ql(i,k)+ (1-beta)*ql(i,k+1))
2987! dqmdt(i,k)=(mc(i,k)*(qhat(i,k)-q(i,k))
2988! 1 +mc(i,k+1)*(q(i,k)-qhat(i,k+1)))/dp(i,k)
2989! 2 +du(i,k)*(qs(i,k)-q(i,k))
2990! 3 +du(i,k)*(beta*ql(i,k)+(1-beta)*ql(i,k+1))
2991
2992 dqmdt(i,k) = (mu(i,k+1)* (qu(i,k+1)-qhat(i,k+1)+cp/rl* (su(i,k+1)-s(i,k)))- &
2993 mu(i,k)* (qu(i,k)-qhat(i,k)+cp/rl*(su(i,k)-s(i,k)))+md(i,k+1)* &
2994 (qd(i,k+1)-qhat(i,k+1)+cp/rl*(sd(i,k+1)-s(i,k)))-md(i,k)* &
2995 (qd(i,k)-qhat(i,k)+cp/rl*(sd(i,k)-s(i,k))))/dp(i,k) + &
2996 du(i,k)* (beta*ql(i,k)+(1-beta)*ql(i,k+1))
2997 end if
2998 end do
2999 end do
3000!
300113700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
300258463347216430 do i = il1g,il2g
300358463348588033 if (k >= lel(i) .and. k <= lcl(i)) then
300420338294067658 thetavp(i,k) = tp(i,k)* (1000._r8/p(i,k))** (rd/cp)*(1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)-q(i,mx(i)))
300520338294067658 thetavm(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1000._r8/p(i,k))** (rd/cp)*(1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,k))
3006 dqsdtp(i,k) = qstp(i,k)* (1._r8+qstp(i,k)/eps1)*eps1*rl/(rd*tp(i,k)**2)
3007!
3008! dtpdt is the parcel temperature change due to change of
3009! subcloud layer properties during convection.
3010!
3011 dtpdt(i,k) = tp(i,k)/ (1._r8+rl/cp* (dqsdtp(i,k)-qstp(i,k)/tp(i,k)))* &
3012 (dtbdt(i)/t(i,mx(i))+rl/cp* (dqbdt(i)/tl(i)-q(i,mx(i))/ &
3013 tl(i)**2*dtldt(i)))
3014!
3015! dboydt is the integrand of cape change.
3016!
3017 dboydt(i,k) = ((dtpdt(i,k)/tp(i,k)+1._r8/(1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)-q(i,mx(i)))* &
3018 (1.608_r8 * dqsdtp(i,k) * dtpdt(i,k) -dqbdt(i))) - (dtmdt(i,k)/t(i,k)+0.608_r8/ &
3019 (1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,k))*dqmdt(i,k)))*grav*thetavp(i,k)/thetavm(i,k)
3020 end if
3021 end do
3022 end do
3023!
302413700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
302558463347216430 do i = il1g,il2g
302658463346554204 if (k > lcl(i) .and. k < mx(i)) then
3027473331946662 thetavp(i,k) = tp(i,k)* (1000._r8/p(i,k))** (rd/cp)*(1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,mx(i)))
3028473331946662 thetavm(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1000._r8/p(i,k))** (rd/cp)*(1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,k))
3029!
3030! dboydt is the integrand of cape change.
3031!
3032 dboydt(i,k) = (dtbdt(i)/t(i,mx(i))+0.608_r8/ (1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,mx(i)))*dqbdt(i)- &
3033 dtmdt(i,k)/t(i,k)-0.608_r8/ (1._r8+0.608_r8*q(i,k))*dqmdt(i,k))* &
3034 grav*thetavp(i,k)/thetavm(i,k)
3035 end if
3036 end do
3037 end do
3038
3039!
3040! buoyant energy change is set to 2/3*excess cape per 3 hours
3041!
3042224859330251 dadt(il1g:il2g) = 0._r8
3043224859695786 kmin = minval(lel(il1g:il2g))
3044224859664397 kmax = maxval(mx(il1g:il2g)) - 1
3045702042702042 do k = kmin, kmax
304630625313764573 do i = il1g,il2g
304730625315579280 if ( k >= lel(i) .and. k <= mx(i) - 1) then
304825046172504617 dadt(i) = dadt(i) + dboydt(i,k)* (zf(i,k)-zf(i,k+1))
3049 endif
3050 end do
3051 end do
3052224859277555 do i = il1g,il2g
3053224859224859 dltaa = -1._r8* (cape(i)-capelmt)
3054222498222498 if (dadt(i) /= 0._r8) mb(i) = max(dltaa/tau/dadt(i),0._r8)
3055 end do
3056!
3057 return
30585269652696end subroutine closure
3059
30605269652696subroutine q1q2_pjr(lchnk , &
3061 dqdt ,dsdt ,q ,qs ,qu , &
3062 su ,du ,qhat ,shat ,dp , &
3063 mu ,md ,sd ,qd ,ql , &
3064 dsubcld ,jt ,mx ,il1g ,il2g , &
3065 cp ,rl ,msg , &
3066 dl ,evp ,cu )
3067
3068
3069 implicit none
3070
3071!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3072!
3073! Purpose:
3074! <Say what the routine does>
3075!
3076! Method:
3077! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
3078! <Also include any applicable external references.>
3079!
3080! Author: phil rasch dec 19 1995
3081!
3082!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3083
3084
3085 real(r8), intent(in) :: cp
3086
3087 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
3088 integer, intent(in) :: il1g
3089 integer, intent(in) :: il2g
3090 integer, intent(in) :: msg
3091
3092 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver)
3093 real(r8), intent(in) :: qs(pcols,pver)
3094 real(r8), intent(in) :: qu(pcols,pver)
3095 real(r8), intent(in) :: su(pcols,pver)
3096 real(r8), intent(in) :: du(pcols,pver)
3097 real(r8), intent(in) :: qhat(pcols,pver)
3098 real(r8), intent(in) :: shat(pcols,pver)
3099 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(pcols,pver)
3100 real(r8), intent(in) :: mu(pcols,pver)
3101 real(r8), intent(in) :: md(pcols,pver)
3102 real(r8), intent(in) :: sd(pcols,pver)
3103 real(r8), intent(in) :: qd(pcols,pver)
3104 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(pcols,pver)
3105 real(r8), intent(in) :: evp(pcols,pver)
3106 real(r8), intent(in) :: cu(pcols,pver)
3107 real(r8), intent(in) :: dsubcld(pcols)
3108
3109 real(r8),intent(out) :: dqdt(pcols,pver),dsdt(pcols,pver)
3110 real(r8),intent(out) :: dl(pcols,pver)
3111 integer kbm
3112 integer ktm
3113 integer jt(pcols)
3114 integer mx(pcols)
3115!
3116! work fields:
3117!
3118 integer i
3119 integer k
3120
3121 real(r8) emc
3122 real(r8) rl
3123!-------------------------------------------------------------------
312413700961422792 do k = msg + 1,pver
312558463347216430 do i = il1g,il2g
3126 dsdt(i,k) = 0._r8
3127 dqdt(i,k) = 0._r8
3128 dl(i,k) = 0._r8
3129 end do
3130 end do
3131!
3132! find the highest level top and bottom levels of convection
3133!
31345269652696 ktm = pver
3135 kbm = pver
3136224859224859 do i = il1g, il2g
3137 ktm = min(ktm,jt(i))
3138 kbm = min(kbm,mx(i))
3139 end do
3140
3141658011710707 do k = ktm,pver-1
314228988323556843 do i = il1g,il2g
3143 emc = -cu (i,k) & ! condensation in updraft
3144 +evp(i,k) ! evaporating rain in downdraft
3145
3146 dsdt(i,k) = -rl/cp*emc &
3147 + (+mu(i,k+1)* (su(i,k+1)-shat(i,k+1)) &
3148 -mu(i,k)* (su(i,k)-shat(i,k)) &
3149 +md(i,k+1)* (sd(i,k+1)-shat(i,k+1)) &
3150 -md(i,k)* (sd(i,k)-shat(i,k)) &
3151 )/dp(i,k)
3152
3153 dqdt(i,k) = emc + &
3154 (+mu(i,k+1)* (qu(i,k+1)-qhat(i,k+1)) &
3155 -mu(i,k)* (qu(i,k)-qhat(i,k)) &
3156 +md(i,k+1)* (qd(i,k+1)-qhat(i,k+1)) &
3157 -md(i,k)* (qd(i,k)-qhat(i,k)) &
3158 )/dp(i,k)
3159
3160 dl(i,k) = du(i,k)*ql(i,k+1)
3161
3162 end do
3163 end do
3164
3165!
3166!DIR$ NOINTERCHANGE!
316764214116910 do k = kbm,pver
3168282653346867 do i = il1g,il2g
3169282653282653 if (k == mx(i)) then
3170224859224859 dsdt(i,k) = (1._r8/dsubcld(i))* &
3171 (-mu(i,k)* (su(i,k)-shat(i,k)) &
3172 -md(i,k)* (sd(i,k)-shat(i,k)) &
3173 )
3174 dqdt(i,k) = (1._r8/dsubcld(i))* &
3175 (-mu(i,k)*(qu(i,k)-qhat(i,k)) &
3176 -md(i,k)*(qd(i,k)-qhat(i,k)) &
3177 )
31785779457794 else if (k > mx(i)) then
31791222312223 dsdt(i,k) = dsdt(i,k-1)
3180 dqdt(i,k) = dqdt(i,k-1)
3181 end if
3182 end do
3183 end do
3184!
3185 return
31865269652696end subroutine q1q2_pjr
3187
31885324853248subroutine buoyan_dilute(lchnk ,ncol , &
3189 q ,t ,p ,z ,pf , &
3190 tp ,qstp ,tl ,rl ,cape , &
3191 pblt ,lcl ,lel ,lon ,mx , &
3192 rd ,grav ,cp ,msg , &
3193 tpert , org , landfrac)
3194!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3195!
3196! Purpose:
3197! Calculates CAPE the lifting condensation level and the convective top
3198! where buoyancy is first -ve.
3199!
3200! Method: Calculates the parcel temperature based on a simple constant
3201! entraining plume model. CAPE is integrated from buoyancy.
3202! 09/09/04 - Simplest approach using an assumed entrainment rate for
3203! testing (dmpdp).
3204! 08/04/05 - Swap to convert dmpdz to dmpdp
3205!
3206! SCAM Logical Switches - DILUTE:RBN - Now Disabled
3207! ---------------------
3208! switch(1) = .T. - Uses the dilute parcel calculation to obtain tendencies.
3209! switch(2) = .T. - Includes entropy/q changes due to condensate loss and freezing.
3210! switch(3) = .T. - Adds the PBL Tpert for the parcel temperature at all levels.
3211!
3212! References:
3213! Raymond and Blythe (1992) JAS
3214!
3215! Author:
3216! Richard Neale - September 2004
3217!
3218!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3219 implicit none
3220!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3221!
3222! input arguments
3223!
3224 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
3225 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3226
3227 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver) ! spec. humidity
3228 real(r8), intent(in) :: t(pcols,pver) ! temperature
3229 real(r8), intent(in) :: p(pcols,pver) ! pressure
3230 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! height
3231 real(r8), intent(in) :: pf(pcols,pver+1) ! pressure at interfaces
3232 real(r8), intent(in) :: pblt(pcols) ! index of pbl depth
3233 real(r8), intent(in) :: tpert(pcols) ! perturbation temperature by pbl processes
3234
3235!
3236! output arguments
3237!
3238 real(r8), intent(out) :: tp(pcols,pver) ! parcel temperature
3239 real(r8), intent(out) :: qstp(pcols,pver) ! saturation mixing ratio of parcel (only above lcl, just q below).
3240 real(r8), intent(out) :: tl(pcols) ! parcel temperature at lcl
3241 real(r8), intent(out) :: cape(pcols) ! convective aval. pot. energy.
3242 integer lcl(pcols) !
3243 integer lel(pcols) !
3244 integer lon(pcols) ! level of onset of deep convection
3245 integer mx(pcols) ! level of max moist static energy
3246
3247 real(r8), pointer :: org(:,:) ! organization parameter
3248 real(r8), intent(in) :: landfrac(pcols)
3249!
3250!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
3251!
3252 real(r8) capeten(pcols,5) ! provisional value of cape
3253 real(r8) tv(pcols,pver) !
3254 real(r8) tpv(pcols,pver) !
3255 real(r8) buoy(pcols,pver)
3256
3257 real(r8) a1(pcols)
3258 real(r8) a2(pcols)
3259 real(r8) estp(pcols)
3260 real(r8) pl(pcols)
3261 real(r8) plexp(pcols)
3262 real(r8) hmax(pcols)
3263 real(r8) hmn(pcols)
3264 real(r8) y(pcols)
3265
3266 logical plge600(pcols)
3267 integer knt(pcols)
3268 integer lelten(pcols,5)
3269
3270 real(r8) cp
3271 real(r8) e
3272 real(r8) grav
3273
3274 integer i
3275 integer k
3276 integer msg
3277 integer n
3278
3279 real(r8) rd
3280 real(r8) rl
3281#ifdef PERGRO
3282 real(r8) rhd
3283#endif
3284!
3285!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3286!
3287266240319488 do n = 1,5
328835947603861000 do i = 1,ncol
3289 lelten(i,n) = pver
3290 capeten(i,n) = 0._r8
3291 end do
3292 end do
3293!
3294718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
3295 lon(i) = pver
3296 knt(i) = 0
3297 lel(i) = pver
3298 mx(i) = lon(i)
3299 cape(i) = 0._r8
3300 hmax(i) = 0._r8
3301 end do
3302
33032156856026467376 tp(:ncol,:) = t(:ncol,:)
33042156856026467376 qstp(:ncol,:) = q(:ncol,:)
3305
3306!!! RBN - Initialize tv and buoy for output.
3307!!! tv=tv : tpv=tpv : qstp=q : buoy=0.
33082156856026467376 tv(:ncol,:) = t(:ncol,:) *(1._r8+1.608_r8*q(:ncol,:))/ (1._r8+q(:ncol,:))
33092156856026467376 tpv(:ncol,:) = tv(:ncol,:)
33102156856026467376 buoy(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
3311
3312!
3313! set "launching" level(mx) to be at maximum moist static energy.
3314! search for this level stops at planetary boundary layer top.
3315!
3316#ifdef PERGRO
3317 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
3318 do i = 1,ncol
3319 hmn(i) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*q(i,k)
3320!
3321! Reset max moist static energy level when relative difference exceeds 1.e-4
3322!
3323 rhd = (hmn(i) - hmax(i))/(hmn(i) + hmax(i))
3324 if (k >= nint(pblt(i)) .and. k <= lon(i) .and. rhd > -1.e-4_r8) then
3325 hmax(i) = hmn(i)
3326 mx(i) = k
3327 end if
3328 end do
3329 end do
3330#else
333113844481437696 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
33321869275220077200 do i = 1,ncol
33331869275218692752 hmn(i) = cp*t(i,k) + grav*z(i,k) + rl*q(i,k)
33341869275223121112 if (k >= nint(pblt(i)) .and. k <= lon(i) .and. hmn(i) > hmax(i)) then
3335841108841108 hmax(i) = hmn(i)
3336 mx(i) = k
3337 end if
3338 end do
3339 end do
3340#endif
3341
3342! LCL dilute calculation - initialize to mx(i)
3343! Determine lcl in parcel_dilute and get pl,tl after parcel_dilute
3344! Original code actually sets LCL as level above wher condensate forms.
3345! Therefore in parcel_dilute lcl(i) will be at first level where qsmix < qtmix.
3346
3347718952772200 do i = 1,ncol ! Initialise LCL variables.
3348 lcl(i) = mx(i)
3349 tl(i) = t(i,mx(i))
3350 pl(i) = p(i,mx(i))
3351 end do
3352
3353!
3354! main buoyancy calculation.
3355!
3356!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
3357!!! DILUTE PLUME CALCULATION USING ENTRAINING PLUME !!!
3358!!! RBN 9/9/04 !!!
3359
33605324853248 call parcel_dilute(lchnk, ncol, msg, mx, p, t, q, &
3361 tpert, tp, tpv, qstp, pl, tl, lcl, &
3362 org, landfrac)
3363
3364
3365! If lcl is above the nominal level of non-divergence (600 mbs),
3366! no deep convection is permitted (ensuing calculations
3367! skipped and cape retains initialized value of zero).
3368!
3369718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
33707189521437904 plge600(i) = pl(i).ge.600._r8 ! Just change to always allow buoy calculation.
3371 end do
3372
3373!
3374! Main buoyancy calculation.
3375!
337613844481437696 do k = pver,msg + 1,-1
33771869275220077200 do i=1,ncol
33781869275237230863 if (k <= mx(i) .and. plge600(i)) then ! Define buoy from launch level to cloud top.
33791820818418208184 tv(i,k) = t(i,k)* (1._r8+1.608_r8*q(i,k))/ (1._r8+q(i,k))
3380 buoy(i,k) = tpv(i,k) - tv(i,k) + tiedke_add ! +0.5K or not?
3381 else
3382484568484568 qstp(i,k) = q(i,k)
3383 tp(i,k) = t(i,k)
3384 tpv(i,k) = tv(i,k)
3385 endif
3386 end do
3387 end do
3388
3389
3390
3391!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3392
3393!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
3394
3395
3396
3397!
339813312001384448 do k = msg + 2,pver
33991797380019305000 do i = 1,ncol
34001797380032446232 if (k < lcl(i) .and. plge600(i)) then
34011427377717230136 if (buoy(i,k+1) > 0._r8 .and. buoy(i,k) <= 0._r8) then
3402684768684768 knt(i) = min(5,knt(i) + 1)
3403 lelten(i,knt(i)) = k
3404 end if
3405 end if
3406 end do
3407 end do
3408!
3409! calculate convective available potential energy (cape).
3410!
3411266240319488 do n = 1,5
341269222407188480 do k = msg + 1,pver
341393463760100386000 do i = 1,ncol
341493463760276282600 if (plge600(i) .and. k <= mx(i) .and. k > lelten(i,n)) then
3415628993912579878 capeten(i,n) = capeten(i,n) + rd*buoy(i,k)*log(pf(i,k+1)/pf(i,k))
3416 end if
3417 end do
3418 end do
3419 end do
3420!
3421! find maximum cape from all possible tentative capes from
3422! one sounding,
3423! and use it as the final cape, april 26, 1995
3424!
3425266240319488 do n = 1,5
342635947603861000 do i = 1,ncol
342735947603594760 if (capeten(i,n) > cape(i)) then
3428596607596607 cape(i) = capeten(i,n)
3429 lel(i) = lelten(i,n)
3430 end if
3431 end do
3432 end do
3433!
3434! put lower bound on cape for diagnostic purposes.
3435!
3436718952772200 do i = 1,ncol
3437 cape(i) = max(cape(i), 0._r8)
3438 end do
3439!
3440 return
34415324853248end subroutine buoyan_dilute
3442
34435324853248subroutine parcel_dilute (lchnk, ncol, msg, klaunch, p, t, q, &
3444 tpert, tp, tpv, qstp, pl, tl, lcl, &
3445 org, landfrac)
3446
3447! Routine to determine
3448! 1. Tp - Parcel temperature
3449! 2. qstp - Saturated mixing ratio at the parcel temperature.
3450
3451!--------------------
3452implicit none
3453!--------------------
3454
3455integer, intent(in) :: lchnk
3456integer, intent(in) :: ncol
3457integer, intent(in) :: msg
3458
3459integer, intent(in), dimension(pcols) :: klaunch(pcols)
3460
3461real(r8), intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: p
3462real(r8), intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: t
3463real(r8), intent(in), dimension(pcols,pver) :: q
3464real(r8), intent(in), dimension(pcols) :: tpert ! PBL temperature perturbation.
3465
3466real(r8), intent(inout), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tp ! Parcel temp.
3467real(r8), intent(inout), dimension(pcols,pver) :: qstp ! Parcel water vapour (sat value above lcl).
3468real(r8), intent(inout), dimension(pcols) :: tl ! Actual temp of LCL.
3469real(r8), intent(inout), dimension(pcols) :: pl ! Actual pressure of LCL.
3470
3471integer, intent(inout), dimension(pcols) :: lcl ! Lifting condesation level (first model level with saturation).
3472
3473real(r8), intent(out), dimension(pcols,pver) :: tpv ! Define tpv within this routine.
3474
3475real(r8), pointer, dimension(:,:) :: org
3476real(r8), intent(in), dimension(pcols) :: landfrac
3477!--------------------
3478
3479! Have to be careful as s is also dry static energy.
3480
3481
3482! If we are to retain the fact that CAM loops over grid-points in the internal
3483! loop then we need to dimension sp,atp,mp,xsh2o with ncol.
3484
3485
3486real(r8) tmix(pcols,pver) ! Tempertaure of the entraining parcel.
3487real(r8) qtmix(pcols,pver) ! Total water of the entraining parcel.
3488real(r8) qsmix(pcols,pver) ! Saturated mixing ratio at the tmix.
3489real(r8) smix(pcols,pver) ! Entropy of the entraining parcel.
3490real(r8) xsh2o(pcols,pver) ! Precipitate lost from parcel.
3491real(r8) ds_xsh2o(pcols,pver) ! Entropy change due to loss of condensate.
3492real(r8) ds_freeze(pcols,pver) ! Entropy change sue to freezing of precip.
3493real(r8) dmpdz2d(pcols,pver) ! variable detrainment rate
3494
3495real(r8) mp(pcols) ! Parcel mass flux.
3496real(r8) qtp(pcols) ! Parcel total water.
3497real(r8) sp(pcols) ! Parcel entropy.
3498
3499real(r8) sp0(pcols) ! Parcel launch entropy.
3500real(r8) qtp0(pcols) ! Parcel launch total water.
3501real(r8) mp0(pcols) ! Parcel launch relative mass flux.
3502
3503real(r8) lwmax ! Maximum condesate that can be held in cloud before rainout.
3504real(r8) dmpdp ! Parcel fractional mass entrainment rate (/mb).
3505!real(r8) dmpdpc ! In cloud parcel mass entrainment rate (/mb).
3506real(r8) dmpdz ! Parcel fractional mass entrainment rate (/m)
3507real(r8) dpdz,dzdp ! Hydrstatic relation and inverse of.
3508real(r8) senv ! Environmental entropy at each grid point.
3509real(r8) qtenv ! Environmental total water " " ".
3510real(r8) penv ! Environmental total pressure " " ".
3511real(r8) tenv ! Environmental total temperature " " ".
3512real(r8) new_s ! Hold value for entropy after condensation/freezing adjustments.
3513real(r8) new_q ! Hold value for total water after condensation/freezing adjustments.
3514real(r8) dp ! Layer thickness (center to center)
3515real(r8) tfguess ! First guess for entropy inversion - crucial for efficiency!
3516real(r8) tscool ! Super cooled temperature offset (in degC) (eg -35).
3517
3518real(r8) qxsk, qxskp1 ! LCL excess water (k, k+1)
3519real(r8) dsdp, dqtdp, dqxsdp ! LCL s, qt, p gradients (k, k+1)
3520real(r8) slcl,qtlcl,qslcl ! LCL s, qt, qs values.
3521real(r8) org2rkm, org2Tpert
3522real(r8) dmpdz_lnd, dmpdz_mask
3523
3524integer rcall ! Number of ientropy call for errors recording
3525integer nit_lheat ! Number of iterations for condensation/freezing loop.
3526integer i,k,ii ! Loop counters.
3527
3528!======================================================================
3529! SUMMARY
3530!
3531! 9/9/04 - Assumes parcel is initiated from level of maxh (klaunch)
3532! and entrains at each level with a specified entrainment rate.
3533!
3534! 15/9/04 - Calculates lcl(i) based on k where qsmix is first < qtmix.
3535!
3536!======================================================================
3537!
3538! Set some values that may be changed frequently.
3539!
3540
35415324853248if (zm_org) then
354200 org2rkm = 10._r8
3543 org2Tpert = 0._r8
3544endif
35455324853248nit_lheat = 2 ! iterations for ds,dq changes from condensation freezing.
3546dmpdz=-1.e-3_r8 ! Entrainment rate. (-ve for /m)
3547dmpdz_lnd=-1.e-3_r8
3548!dmpdpc = 3.e-2_r8 ! In cloud entrainment rate (/mb).
3549lwmax = 1.e-3_r8 ! Need to put formula in for this.
3550tscool = 0.0_r8 ! Temp at which water loading freezes in the cloud.
3551
35522555904030404608qtmix=0._r8
35532555904030457856smix=0._r8
3554
35555324853248qtenv = 0._r8
3556senv = 0._r8
3557tenv = 0._r8
3558penv = 0._r8
3559
3560851968905216qtp0 = 0._r8
3561851968958464sp0 = 0._r8
3562851968958464mp0 = 0._r8
3563
3564851968958464qtp = 0._r8
3565851968958464sp = 0._r8
3566851968958464mp = 0._r8
3567
35685324853248new_q = 0._r8
3569new_s = 0._r8
3570
3571! **** Begin loops ****
3572
357313844481384448do k = pver, msg+1, -1
35741869275220077200 do i=1,ncol
3575
3576! Initialize parcel values at launch level.
3577
35781869275218692752 if (k == klaunch(i)) then
3579718952718952 qtp0(i) = q(i,k) ! Parcel launch total water (assuming subsaturated) - OK????.
35807189521437904 sp0(i) = entropy(t(i,k),p(i,k),qtp0(i)) ! Parcel launch entropy.
3581 mp0(i) = 1._r8 ! Parcel launch relative mass (i.e. 1 parcel stays 1 parcel for dmpdp=0, undilute).
3582 smix(i,k) = sp0(i)
3583 qtmix(i,k) = qtp0(i)
3584 tfguess = t(i,k)
3585 rcall = 1
3586718952718952 call ientropy (rcall,i,lchnk,smix(i,k),p(i,k),qtmix(i,k),tmix(i,k),qsmix(i,k),tfguess)
3587 end if
3588
3589! Entraining levels
3590
35911869275218692752 if (k < klaunch(i)) then
3592
3593! Set environmental values for this level.
3594
35951781915917819159 dp = (p(i,k)-p(i,k+1)) ! In -ve mb as p decreasing with height - difference between center of layers.
3596 qtenv = 0.5_r8*(q(i,k)+q(i,k+1)) ! Total water of environment.
3597 tenv = 0.5_r8*(t(i,k)+t(i,k+1))
3598 penv = 0.5_r8*(p(i,k)+p(i,k+1))
3599
36001781915935638318 senv = entropy(tenv,penv,qtenv) ! Entropy of environment.
3601
3602! Determine fractional entrainment rate /pa given value /m.
3603
3604 dpdz = -(penv*grav)/(rgas*tenv) ! in mb/m since p in mb.
3605 dzdp = 1._r8/dpdz ! in m/mb
3606 if (zm_org) then
360700 dmpdz_mask = landfrac(i) * dmpdz_lnd + (1._r8 - landfrac(i)) * dmpdz
3608 dmpdp = (dmpdz_mask/(1._r8+org(i,k)*org2rkm))*dzdp ! /mb Fractional entrainment
3609 else
36101781915917819159 dmpdp = dmpdz*dzdp
3611 endif
3612
3613! Sum entrainment to current level
3614! entrains q,s out of intervening dp layers, in which linear variation is assumed
3615! so really it entrains the mean of the 2 stored values.
3616
36171781915917819159 sp(i) = sp(i) - dmpdp*dp*senv
3618 qtp(i) = qtp(i) - dmpdp*dp*qtenv
3619 mp(i) = mp(i) - dmpdp*dp
3620
3621! Entrain s and qt to next level.
3622
3623 smix(i,k) = (sp0(i) + sp(i)) / (mp0(i) + mp(i))
3624 qtmix(i,k) = (qtp0(i) + qtp(i)) / (mp0(i) + mp(i))
3625
3626! Invert entropy from s and q to determine T and saturation-capped q of mixture.
3627! t(i,k) used as a first guess so that it converges faster.
3628
3629 tfguess = tmix(i,k+1)
3630 rcall = 2
36311781915917819159 call ientropy(rcall,i,lchnk,smix(i,k),p(i,k),qtmix(i,k),tmix(i,k),qsmix(i,k),tfguess)
3632
3633!
3634! Determine if this is lcl of this column if qsmix <= qtmix.
3635! FIRST LEVEL where this happens on ascending.
3636
36371781915933716410 if (qsmix(i,k) <= qtmix(i,k) .and. qsmix(i,k+1) > qtmix(i,k+1)) then
3638701542701542 lcl(i) = k
3639 qxsk = qtmix(i,k) - qsmix(i,k)
3640 qxskp1 = qtmix(i,k+1) - qsmix(i,k+1)
3641 dqxsdp = (qxsk - qxskp1)/dp
3642 pl(i) = p(i,k+1) - qxskp1/dqxsdp ! pressure level of actual lcl.
3643 dsdp = (smix(i,k) - smix(i,k+1))/dp
3644 dqtdp = (qtmix(i,k) - qtmix(i,k+1))/dp
3645 slcl = smix(i,k+1) + dsdp* (pl(i)-p(i,k+1))
3646 qtlcl = qtmix(i,k+1) + dqtdp*(pl(i)-p(i,k+1))
3647
3648 tfguess = tmix(i,k)
3649 rcall = 3
3650701542701542 call ientropy (rcall,i,lchnk,slcl,pl(i),qtlcl,tl(i),qslcl,tfguess)
3651
3652! write(iulog,*)' '
3653! write(iulog,*)' p',p(i,k+1),pl(i),p(i,lcl(i))
3654! write(iulog,*)' t',tmix(i,k+1),tl(i),tmix(i,lcl(i))
3655! write(iulog,*)' s',smix(i,k+1),slcl,smix(i,lcl(i))
3656! write(iulog,*)'qt',qtmix(i,k+1),qtlcl,qtmix(i,lcl(i))
3657! write(iulog,*)'qs',qsmix(i,k+1),qslcl,qsmix(i,lcl(i))
3658
3659 endif
3660!
3661 end if ! k < klaunch
3662
3663
3664 end do ! Levels loop
3665end do ! Columns loop
3666
3667!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!END ENTRAINMENT LOOP!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
3668
3669!! Could stop now and test with this as it will provide some estimate of buoyancy
3670!! without the effects of freezing/condensation taken into account for tmix.
3671
3672!! So we now have a profile of entropy and total water of the entraining parcel
3673!! Varying with height from the launch level klaunch parcel=environment. To the
3674!! top allowed level for the existence of convection.
3675
3676!! Now we have to adjust these values such that the water held in vaopor is < or
3677!! = to qsmix. Therefore, we assume that the cloud holds a certain amount of
3678!! condensate (lwmax) and the rest is rained out (xsh2o). This, obviously
3679!! provides latent heating to the mixed parcel and so this has to be added back
3680!! to it. But does this also increase qsmix as well? Also freezing processes
3681
3682
36832555904030457856xsh2o = 0._r8
36842555904030457856ds_xsh2o = 0._r8
36852555904030457856ds_freeze = 0._r8
3686
3687!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!PRECIPITATION/FREEZING LOOP!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
3688!! Iterate solution twice for accuracy
3689
3690
3691
369213844481437696do k = pver, msg+1, -1
36931869275220077200 do i=1,ncol
3694
3695! Initialize variables at k=klaunch
3696
36971869275218692752 if (k == klaunch(i)) then
3698
3699! Set parcel values at launch level assume no liquid water.
3700
3701718952718952 tp(i,k) = tmix(i,k)
3702 qstp(i,k) = q(i,k)
3703 if (zm_org) then
370400 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k) + (org2Tpert*org(i,k)+tpert(i))) * (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)) / (1._r8+qstp(i,k))
3705 else
3706718952718952 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k) + tpert(i)) * (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)) / (1._r8+qstp(i,k))
3707 endif
3708
3709 end if
3710
37111869275218692752 if (k < klaunch(i)) then
3712
3713! Initiaite loop if switch(2) = .T. - RBN:DILUTE - TAKEN OUT BUT COULD BE RETURNED LATER.
3714
3715! Iterate nit_lheat times for s,qt changes.
3716
37173563831853457477 do ii=0,nit_lheat-1
3718
3719! Rain (xsh2o) is excess condensate, bar LWMAX (Accumulated loss from qtmix).
3720
37213563831835638318 xsh2o(i,k) = max (0._r8, qtmix(i,k) - qsmix(i,k) - lwmax)
3722
3723! Contribution to ds from precip loss of condensate (Accumulated change from smix).(-ve)
3724
37253563831871276636 ds_xsh2o(i,k) = ds_xsh2o(i,k+1) - cpliq * log (tmix(i,k)/tfreez) * max(0._r8,(xsh2o(i,k)-xsh2o(i,k+1)))
3726!
3727! Entropy of freezing: latice times amount of water involved divided by T.
3728!
3729
37302685391226853912 if (tmix(i,k) <= tfreez+tscool .and. ds_freeze(i,k+1) == 0._r8) then ! One off freezing of condensate.
373123810422381042 ds_freeze(i,k) = (latice/tmix(i,k)) * max(0._r8,qtmix(i,k)-qsmix(i,k)-xsh2o(i,k)) ! Gain of LH
3732 end if
3733
37343563831862492230 if (tmix(i,k) <= tfreez+tscool .and. ds_freeze(i,k+1) /= 0._r8) then ! Continual freezing of additional condensate.
37352447287024472870 ds_freeze(i,k) = ds_freeze(i,k+1)+(latice/tmix(i,k)) * max(0._r8,(qsmix(i,k+1)-qsmix(i,k)))
3736 end if
3737
3738! Adjust entropy and accordingly to sum of ds (be careful of signs).
3739
37403563831835638318 new_s = smix(i,k) + ds_xsh2o(i,k) + ds_freeze(i,k)
3741
3742! Adjust liquid water and accordingly to xsh2o.
3743
3744 new_q = qtmix(i,k) - xsh2o(i,k)
3745
3746! Invert entropy to get updated Tmix and qsmix of parcel.
3747
3748 tfguess = tmix(i,k)
3749 rcall =4
37503563831835638318 call ientropy (rcall,i,lchnk,new_s, p(i,k), new_q, tmix(i,k), qsmix(i,k), tfguess)
3751
3752 end do ! Iteration loop for freezing processes.
3753
3754! tp - Parcel temp is temp of mixture.
3755! tpv - Parcel v. temp should be density temp with new_q total water.
3756
37571781915917819159 tp(i,k) = tmix(i,k)
3758
3759! tpv = tprho in the presence of condensate (i.e. when new_q > qsmix)
3760
3761 if (new_q > qsmix(i,k)) then ! Super-saturated so condensate present - reduces buoyancy.
3762 qstp(i,k) = qsmix(i,k)
3763 else ! Just saturated/sub-saturated - no condensate virtual effects.
3764 qstp(i,k) = new_q
3765 end if
3766
3767 if (zm_org) then
376800 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k)+(org2Tpert*org(i,k)+tpert(i)))* (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)) / (1._r8+ new_q)
3769 else
37701781915917819159 tpv(i,k) = (tp(i,k)+tpert(i))* (1._r8+1.608_r8*qstp(i,k)) / (1._r8+ new_q)
3771 endif
3772
3773 end if ! k < klaunch
3774
3775 end do ! Loop for columns
3776
3777end do ! Loop for vertical levels.
3778
3779
3780return
37815324853248end subroutine parcel_dilute
3782
3783!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3784355731341355731341real(r8) function entropy(TK,p,qtot)
3785!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3786!
3787! TK(K),p(mb),qtot(kg/kg)
3788! from Raymond and Blyth 1992
3789!
3790 real(r8), intent(in) :: p,qtot,TK
3791 real(r8) :: qv,qst,e,est,L
3792 real(r8), parameter :: pref = 1000._r8
3793
3794355731341355731341L = rl - (cpliq - cpwv)*(TK-tfreez) ! T IN CENTIGRADE
3795
3796355731341355731341call qsat_hPa(TK, p, est, qst)
3797
3798355731341355731341qv = min(qtot,qst) ! Partition qtot into vapor part only.
3799e = qv*p / (eps1 +qv)
3800
38013557313411067194023entropy = (cpres + qtot*cpliq)*log( TK/tfreez) - rgas*log( (p-e)/pref ) + &
3802355731341355731341 L*qv/TK - qv*rh2o*log(qv/qst)
3803
3804355731341355731341end FUNCTION entropy
3805
3806!
3807!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
38085487797154877971SUBROUTINE ientropy (rcall,icol,lchnk,s,p,qt,T,qst,Tfg)
3809!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3810!
3811! p(mb), Tfg/T(K), qt/qv(kg/kg), s(J/kg).
3812! Inverts entropy, pressure and total water qt
3813! for T and saturated vapor mixing ratio
3814!
3815
3816 use phys_grid, only: get_rlon_p, get_rlat_p
3817
3818 integer, intent(in) :: icol, lchnk, rcall
3819 real(r8), intent(in) :: s, p, Tfg, qt
3820 real(r8), intent(out) :: qst, T
3821 real(r8) :: est, this_lat,this_lon
3822 real(r8) :: a,b,c,d,ebr,fa,fb,fc,pbr,qbr,rbr,sbr,tol1,xm,tol
3823 integer :: i
3824
3825 logical :: converged
3826
3827 ! Max number of iteration loops.
3828 integer, parameter :: LOOPMAX = 100
3829 real(r8), parameter :: EPS = 3.e-8_r8
3830
38315487797154877971 converged = .false.
3832
3833 ! Invert the entropy equation -- use Brent's method
3834 ! Brent, R. P. Ch. 3-4 in Algorithms for Minimization Without Derivatives. Englewood Cliffs, NJ: Prentice-Hall, 1973.
3835
3836 T = Tfg ! Better first guess based on Tprofile from conv.
3837
3838 a = Tfg-10 !low bracket
3839 b = Tfg+10 !high bracket
3840
384154877971109755942 fa = entropy(a, p, qt) - s
384254877971109755942 fb = entropy(b, p, qt) - s
3843
3844 c=b
3845 fc=fb
3846 tol=0.001_r8
3847
3848227437288227437288 converge: do i=0, LOOPMAX
3849282315259637692736 if ((fb > 0.0_r8 .and. fc > 0.0_r8) .or. &
38509201329692013296 (fb < 0.0_r8 .and. fc < 0.0_r8)) then
3851180801982180801982 c=a
3852 fc=fa
3853 d=b-a
3854 ebr=d
3855 end if
3856282315259282315259 if (abs(fc) < abs(fb)) then
38576684422666844226 a=b
3858 b=c
3859 c=a
3860 fa=fb
3861 fb=fc
3862 fc=fa
3863 end if
3864
3865282315259282315259 tol1=2.0_r8*EPS*abs(b)+0.5_r8*tol
3866 xm=0.5_r8*(c-b)
38672823152591129261036 converged = (abs(xm) <= tol1 .or. fb == 0.0_r8)
3868 if (converged) exit converge
3869
3870227437288454874576 if (abs(ebr) >= tol1 .and. abs(fa) > abs(fb)) then
3871227437288227437288 sbr=fb/fa
3872 if (a == c) then
3873125925854125925854 pbr=2.0_r8*xm*sbr
3874 qbr=1.0_r8-sbr
3875 else
3876101511434101511434 qbr=fa/fc
3877 rbr=fb/fc
3878 pbr=sbr*(2.0_r8*xm*qbr*(qbr-rbr)-(b-a)*(rbr-1.0_r8))
3879 qbr=(qbr-1.0_r8)*(rbr-1.0_r8)*(sbr-1.0_r8)
3880 end if
3881227437288324176147 if (pbr > 0.0_r8) qbr=-qbr
3882227437288227437288 pbr=abs(pbr)
3883 if (2.0_r8*pbr < min(3.0_r8*xm*qbr-abs(tol1*qbr),abs(ebr*qbr))) then
3884222676627222676627 ebr=d
3885 d=pbr/qbr
3886 else
388747606614760661 d=xm
3888 ebr=d
3889 end if
3890 else
389100 d=xm
3892 ebr=d
3893 end if
3894227437288227437288 a=b
3895 fa=fb
3896227437288507627873 b=b+merge(d,sign(tol1,xm), abs(d) > tol1 )
3897
3898227437288227437288 fb = entropy(b, p, qt) - s
3899
3900 end do converge
3901
39025487797154877971 T = b
39035487797154877971 call qsat_hPa(T, p, est, qst)
3904
39055487797154877971 if (.not. converged) then
390600 this_lat = get_rlat_p(lchnk, icol)*57.296_r8
390700 this_lon = get_rlon_p(lchnk, icol)*57.296_r8
390800 write(iulog,*) '*** ZM_CONV: IENTROPY: Failed and about to exit, info follows ****'
390900 write(iulog,100) 'ZM_CONV: IENTROPY. Details: call#,lchnk,icol= ',rcall,lchnk,icol, &
3910 ' lat: ',this_lat,' lon: ',this_lon, &
3911 ' P(mb)= ', p, ' Tfg(K)= ', Tfg, ' qt(g/kg) = ', 1000._r8*qt, &
3912 ' qst(g/kg) = ', 1000._r8*qst,', s(J/kg) = ',s
391300 call endrun('**** ZM_CONV IENTROPY: Tmix did not converge ****')
3914 end if
3915
3916100 format (A,I1,I4,I4,7(A,F6.2))
3917
39185487797154877971end SUBROUTINE ientropy
3919
3920! Wrapper for qsat_water that does translation between Pa and hPa
3921! qsat_water uses Pa internally, so get it right, need to pass in Pa.
3922! Afterward, set es back to hPa.
3923417968589417968589elemental subroutine qsat_hPa(t, p, es, qm)
3924 use wv_saturation, only: qsat_water
3925
3926 ! Inputs
3927 real(r8), intent(in) :: t ! Temperature (K)
3928 real(r8), intent(in) :: p ! Pressure (hPa)
3929 ! Outputs
3930 real(r8), intent(out) :: es ! Saturation vapor pressure (hPa)
3931 real(r8), intent(out) :: qm ! Saturation mass mixing ratio
3932 ! (vapor mass over dry mass, kg/kg)
3933
